describe('splitCommands', () => {
  it('should split chained commands', () => {
    expect(splitCommands('ls -l && git status')).toEqual([
      'ls -l',
      'git status',
    ]);
  });

  it('should filter out redirection tokens but keep command parts', () => {
    // Standard redirection
    expect(splitCommands('echo "hello" > file.txt')).toEqual(['echo "hello"']);
    expect(splitCommands('printf "test" >> log.txt')).toEqual([
      'printf "test"',
    ]);
    expect(splitCommands('cat < input.txt')).toEqual(['cat']);

    // Heredoc/Herestring
    expect(splitCommands('cat << EOF\nhello\nEOF')).toEqual(['cat']);
    // Note: The Tree-sitter bash parser includes the herestring in the main
    // command node's text, unlike standard redirections which are siblings.
    expect(splitCommands('grep "foo" <<< "foobar"')).toEqual([
      'grep "foo" <<< "foobar"',
    ]);
  });

  it('should extract nested commands from process substitution while filtering the redirection operator', () => {
    // This is the key security test: we want cat to be checked, but not the > >(...) wrapper part
    const parts = splitCommands('echo "foo" > >(cat)');
    expect(parts).toContain('echo "foo"');
    expect(parts).toContain('cat');
    expect(parts.some((p) => p.includes('>'))).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('stripShellWrapper', () => {
  it('should strip sh -c with quotes', () => {
    expect(stripShellWrapper('sh -c "ls -l"')).toEqual('ls -l');
  });

  it('should strip bash -c with extra whitespace', () => {
    expect(stripShellWrapper('  bash  -c  "ls -l"  ')).toEqual('ls -l');
  });

  it('should strip zsh -c without quotes', () => {
    expect(stripShellWrapper('zsh -c ls -l')).toEqual('ls -l');
  });

  it('should strip cmd.exe /c', () => {
    expect(stripShellWrapper('cmd.exe /c "dir"')).toEqual('dir');
  });

  it('should strip powershell.exe -Command with optional -NoProfile', () => {
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem"'),
    ).toEqual('Get-ChildItem');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('powershell.exe -Command "Get-ChildItem"'),
    ).toEqual('Get-ChildItem');
  });

  it('should strip pwsh -Command wrapper', () => {
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('pwsh -NoProfile -Command "Get-ChildItem"'),
    ).toEqual('Get-ChildItem');
  });

  it('should strip PowerShell wrappers with -NonInteractive, -NoLogo, and Windows paths', () => {
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        'powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "git log -n 10 --oneline"',
      ),
    ).toEqual('git log -n 10 --oneline');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        'pwsh.exe -NonInteractive -NoProfile -NoLogo -c "Get-ChildItem"',
      ),
    ).toEqual('Get-ChildItem');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        'C:\\Windows\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "git diff main...HEAD --stat"',
      ),
    ).toEqual('git diff main...HEAD --stat');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        '"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "Get-Location"',
      ),
    ).toEqual('Get-Location');
  });

  it('should unescape C-argv escaped quotes inside outer PowerShell -Command "..." without corrupting compound commands', () => {
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "node -e \\"console.log(1)\\""'),
    ).toEqual('node -e "console.log(1)"');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        'powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "node -e \\"console.log(\\\\\\"hello (world)\\\\\\")\\""',
      ),
    ).toEqual('node -e "console.log(\\"hello (world)\\")"');
    expect(stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo a"; whoami')).toEqual(
      '"echo a"; whoami',
    );
    expect(stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo a"; echo "b"')).toEqual(
      'powershell -Command "echo a"; echo "b"',
    );
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('cmd.exe /c "echo a" & whoami & echo "b"'),
    ).toEqual('cmd.exe /c "echo a" & whoami & echo "b"');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        'cmd.exe /c "powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command \\"echo $(whoami)\\""',
      ),
    ).toEqual('echo $(whoami)');
    expect(stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo `$(whoami)"')).toEqual(
      'echo $(whoami)',
    );
    // Refuse to unwrap when unwrapping would hide outer-shell substitution inside single quotes or escaped backticks
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo \'$(whoami)\'"'),
    ).toEqual('powershell -Command "echo \'$(whoami)\'"');
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo \'``$(whoami)\'"'),
    ).toEqual('powershell -Command "echo \'``$(whoami)\'"');
    expect(stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo ``$(whoami)"')).toEqual(
      'echo `$(whoami)',
    );
    expect(stripShellWrapper('bash -c "echo \'$(whoami)\'"')).toEqual(
      'bash -c "echo \'$(whoami)\'"',
    );
    expect(stripShellWrapper('bash -c "echo \\\\$(whoami)"')).toEqual(
      'bash -c "echo \\\\$(whoami)"',
    );
    // Even backslashes before quote in cmd.exe /c close the quote rather than escaping it
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper('cmd.exe /c "echo \\\\"& whoami & echo \\""'),
    ).toEqual('cmd.exe /c "echo \\\\"& whoami & echo \\""');
    // Even backslashes before doubled quotes ("") or closing quote in cmd.exe /c and PowerShell are halved
    expect(stripShellWrapper('cmd.exe /c "echo foo\\\\""bar"')).toEqual(
      'echo foo\\"bar',
    );
    expect(stripShellWrapper('cmd.exe /c "echo C:\\\\"')).toEqual('echo C:\\');
    expect(stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo C:\\\\"')).toEqual(
      'echo C:\\',
    );
  });

  it('should not strip anything if no wrapper is present', () => {
    expect(stripShellWrapper('ls -l')).toEqual('ls -l');
  });

  it('should handle multi-line escaped double quotes correctly', () => {
    const multiLine = 'bash -c "hg commit -m \\"title\n\nbody\\""';
    const expected = 'hg commit -m "title\n\nbody"';
    expect(stripShellWrapper(multiLine)).toEqual(expected);
  });
});

describe('escapeShellArg', () => {
  describe('POSIX (bash)', () => {
    it('should use shell-quote for escaping', () => {
      mockQuote.mockReturnValueOnce("'escaped value'");
      const result = escapeShellArg('raw value', 'bash');
      expect(mockQuote).toHaveBeenCalledWith(['raw value']);
      expect(result).toBe("'escaped value'");
    });

    it('should handle empty strings', () => {
      const result = escapeShellArg('', 'bash');
      expect(result).toBe('');
      expect(mockQuote).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
  });

  describe('Windows', () => {
    describe('when shell is cmd.exe', () => {
      it('should wrap simple arguments in double quotes', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('search term', 'cmd');
        expect(result).toBe('"search term"');
      });

      it('should escape internal double quotes by doubling them', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('hello "world"', 'cmd');
        expect(result).toBe('"hello ""world"""');
      });

      it('should handle empty strings', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('', 'cmd');
        expect(result).toBe('');
      });
    });

    describe('when shell is PowerShell', () => {
      it('should return simple alphanumeric arguments without quotes', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('my-argument-123.txt', 'powershell');
        expect(result).toBe('my-argument-123.txt');
      });

      it('should wrap arguments with spaces in single quotes', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('search term', 'powershell');
        expect(result).toBe("'search term'");
      });

      it('should escape internal single quotes by doubling them', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg("It's a test", 'powershell');
        expect(result).toBe("'It''s a test'");
      });

      it('should handle double quotes without escaping them', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('He said "Hello"', 'powershell');
        expect(result).toBe('\'He said "Hello"\'');
      });

      it('should handle empty strings', () => {
        const result = escapeShellArg('', 'powershell');
        expect(result).toBe('');
      });
    });
  });
});

describe('getShellConfiguration', () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
  });

  it('should return bash configuration on Linux', () => {
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('linux');
    const config = getShellConfiguration();
    expect(config.executable).toBe('bash');
    expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual(['-c']);
    expect(config.shell).toBe('bash');
  });

  it('should return bash configuration on macOS (darwin)', () => {
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('darwin');
    const config = getShellConfiguration();
    expect(config.executable).toBe('bash');
    expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual(['-c']);
    expect(config.shell).toBe('bash');
  });

  describe('on Windows', () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
      mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('win32');
      vi.stubEnv('ComSpec', '');
      mockAccessSync.mockImplementation(() => {
        throw new Error('ENOENT');
      });
    });

    it('should return PowerShell configuration by default', () => {
      const config = getShellConfiguration();
      expect(config.executable).toBe('powershell.exe');
      expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual([
        '-NoProfile',
        '-NonInteractive',
        '-Command',
      ]);
      expect(config.shell).toBe('powershell');
    });

    it.skipIf(!isWindowsRuntime)(
      'should prefer pwsh.exe over powershell.exe when pwsh is available in PATH',
      () => {
        const pwshDir = path.resolve('C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7');
        const pwshPath = path.join(pwshDir, 'pwsh.exe');
        vi.stubEnv('PATH', pwshDir);
        mockAccessSync.mockImplementation((p: string) => {
          if (p === pwshPath) return;
          throw new Error('ENOENT');
        });
        const config = getShellConfiguration();
        expect(config.executable).toBe(pwshPath);
        expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual([
          '-NoProfile',
          '-NonInteractive',
          '-Command',
        ]);
        expect(config.shell).toBe('powershell');
      },
    );

    it('should ignore ComSpec when pointing to cmd.exe', () => {
      vi.stubEnv('ComSpec', 'C:\\WINDOWS\\system32\\cmd.exe');
      const config = getShellConfiguration();
      expect(config.executable).toBe('powershell.exe');
      expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual([
        '-NoProfile',
        '-NonInteractive',
        '-Command',
      ]);
      expect(config.shell).toBe('powershell');
    });

    it('should return PowerShell configuration if ComSpec points to powershell.exe', () => {
      const psPath =
        'C:\\WINDOWS\\System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe';
      vi.stubEnv('ComSpec', psPath);
      const config = getShellConfiguration();
      expect(config.executable).toBe(psPath);
      expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual([
        '-NoProfile',
        '-NonInteractive',
        '-Command',
      ]);
      expect(config.shell).toBe('powershell');
    });

    it('should return PowerShell configuration if ComSpec points to pwsh.exe', () => {
      const pwshPath = 'C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe';
      vi.stubEnv('ComSpec', pwshPath);
      const config = getShellConfiguration();
      expect(config.executable).toBe(pwshPath);
      expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual([
        '-NoProfile',
        '-NonInteractive',
        '-Command',
      ]);
      expect(config.shell).toBe('powershell');
    });

    it('should be case-insensitive when checking ComSpec', () => {
      vi.stubEnv('ComSpec', 'C:\\Path\\To\\POWERSHELL.EXE');
      const config = getShellConfiguration();
      expect(config.executable).toBe('C:\\Path\\To\\POWERSHELL.EXE');
      expect(config.argsPrefix).toEqual([
        '-NoProfile',
        '-NonInteractive',
        '-Command',
      ]);
      expect(config.shell).toBe('powershell');
    });
  });
});

describe('hasRedirection (PowerShell via mock)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('win32');
    process.env['ComSpec'] = 'powershell.exe';
  });

  it('should return true when PowerShell parser detects redirection', () => {
    mockPowerShellResult([{ name: 'echo', text: 'echo hello' }], true);
    expect(hasRedirection('echo hello > file.txt')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('should return false when PowerShell parser does not detect redirection', () => {
    mockPowerShellResult([{ name: 'echo', text: 'echo hello' }], false);
    expect(hasRedirection('echo hello')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should return false when quoted redirection chars are used but not actual redirection', () => {
    mockPowerShellResult(
      [{ name: 'echo', text: 'echo "-> arrow"' }],
      false, // Parser says NO redirection
    );
    expect(hasRedirection('echo "-> arrow"')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should fallback to regex if parsing fails (simulating safety)', () => {
    mockSpawnSync.mockReturnValue({
      stdout: Buffer.from('invalid json'),
      status: 0,
    });
    // Fallback regex sees '>' in arrow
    expect(hasRedirection('echo "-> arrow"')).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('resolveExecutable', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockAccessSync.mockReset();
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
  });

  it('should return the absolute path if it exists and is executable', () => {
    const absPath = path.resolve('/usr/bin/git');
    mockAccessSync.mockImplementation(() => undefined);
    expect(resolveExecutable(absPath)).toBe(absPath);
    expect(mockAccessSync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(absPath, 1);
  });

  it('should return undefined for absolute path if it does not exist', () => {
    const absPath = path.resolve('/usr/bin/nonexistent');
    mockAccessSync.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('ENOENT');
    });
    expect(resolveExecutable(absPath)).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('should resolve executable in PATH', () => {
    const binDir = path.resolve('/bin');
    const usrBinDir = path.resolve('/usr/bin');
    vi.stubEnv('PATH', `${binDir}${path.delimiter}${usrBinDir}`);
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('linux');

    const targetPath = path.join(usrBinDir, 'ls');
    mockAccessSync.mockImplementation((p: string) => {
      if (p === targetPath) return undefined;
      throw new Error('ENOENT');
    });

    expect(resolveExecutable('ls')).toBe(targetPath);
  });

  it('should try extensions on Windows', () => {
    const sys32 = path.resolve('C:\\Windows\\System32');
    vi.stubEnv('PATH', sys32);
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('win32');
    mockAccessSync.mockImplementation((p: string) => {
      if (p.includes('cmd.exe')) return undefined;
      throw new Error('ENOENT');
    });

    expect(resolveExecutable('cmd')).toContain('cmd.exe');
  });

  it('should return undefined if not found in PATH', () => {
    vi.stubEnv('PATH', path.resolve('/bin'));
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('linux');
    mockAccessSync.mockImplementation(() => {
      throw new Error('ENOENT');
    });

    expect(resolveExecutable('unknown')).toBeUndefined();
  });

  it('should return undefined if PATH is unset', () => {
    vi.stubEnv('PATH', '');
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('linux');

    expect(resolveExecutable('anything')).toBeUndefined();
  });
});

describe('detectCommandSubstitution (PowerShell)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockPlatform.mockReturnValue('win32');
    vi.stubEnv('ComSpec', 'powershell.exe');
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
  });

  it('should allow PowerShell instance and static method calls', () => {
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('$str.Trim()')).toBe(false);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution("[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath('foo')"),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        "Get-ChildItem | Where-Object { $_.Name.EndsWith('.ts') }",
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('$arr[0].ToString()')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should allow PowerShell conditionals, compound boolean parens, and param blocks', () => {
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        'if (($a -eq 1) -and ($b -eq 2)) { Write-Host ok }',
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('if (-not ($x)) { Write-Host ok }')).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('while (($i -lt 10)) { $i++ }')).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution('for ($i = 0; $i -lt 10; $i++) { $i }'),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution('& { param($x, [string]$y) Write-Host $x }'),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        'function Test-Helper($x, [int]$y) { $x + $y }',
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should allow Windows paths with parens, braced variables, comments, and here-strings without substitution', () => {
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution('dir "C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Git"'),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution("dir 'C:\\Program Files (x86)\\Git'"),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo ${env:ProgramFiles(x86)}')).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("git status # don't fail (check)")).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution('git status <# block (comment) $(safe) #>'),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo "hello ""(world)"""')).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("echo 'hello ''$(safe)'''")).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("@'\n$(not_expanded)\n(safe)\n'@")).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('@"\nplain (parens) text\n"@')).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('$sum = ($a + $b) * 2')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('should detect genuine PowerShell command substitutions and security edge cases', () => {
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo $(whoami)')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo "$(whoami)"')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('@"\n$(whoami)\n"@')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo @(whoami)')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo (whoami)')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('cmd.exe(whoami)')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("$str.Replace((whoami), 'a')")).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo ($a | Invoke-Expression)')).toBe(
      true,
    );
    // In PowerShell, backslash does not escape quotes, so \" closes the string!
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo "foo\\" @(whoami)"')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo "foo\\" (whoami)"')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo "\\$(whoami)"')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("# don't\necho $(whoami)")).toBe(true);
    // Security hardening: assignments in parens, scriptblock .Invoke(), mid-token here-strings/comments, CR newlines, Unicode quotes
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo ($x = whoami)')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('if ($x = (whoami)) { }')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo ((whoami))')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('{ whoami }.Invoke()')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo foo@"\n$(whoami)\n"@')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("echo foo@'\n'$(whoami)\n'@")).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo foo<# $(whoami) #>')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("@'\n'@; $(whoami)")).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("@'\n\r'@; $(whoami)")).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution("echo 'hello\u2019 $(whoami) '")).toBe(
      true,
    );
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo \u201c$(whoami)\u201d')).toBe(true);
    // Parameter defaults, assignments in conditions, pipelines in conditions, and comment-spoofed parens executing commands
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('if ($a | (whoami)) { }')).toBe(true);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution('for ($i = (whoami); $i -lt 1; $i++) { }'),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('& { param($x = (whoami)) }')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('echo ($a <# ) #> ; whoami)')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('if foo (whoami) { }')).toBe(true);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo \'$(whoami)\'"'),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo `$(whoami)"'),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        stripShellWrapper('powershell -Command "echo ``$(whoami)"'),
      ),
    ).toBe(true);
  });

  it('should run in linear time without ReDoS on large adversarial inputs', () => {
    const start = performance.now();
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution('('.repeat(25_000) + '$a' + ')'.repeat(25_000)),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(
      detectCommandSubstitution(
        '($a + '.repeat(10_000) + '$b' + ')'.repeat(10_000),
      ),
    ).toBe(false);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution(';if a'.repeat(10_000) + '(')).toBe(true);
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('$a.b'.repeat(10_000) + '()')).toBe(false);
    expect(
      stripShellWrapper(
        'powershell.exe ' + '-NoProfile '.repeat(5_000) + 'git status',
      ),
    ).toContain('git status');
    expect(performance.now() - start).toBeLessThan(1000);
  });
});

    expect(stripShellWrapper("sh -c 'echo ok' # comment")).toBe(

  it('should detect command substitution behind quoted env assignments, multi-o flags, escaped backslashes, locale quotes, prefix-flag clusters, xargs, env -S escapes, clobber redirects, and Windows/PowerShell edge cases', () => {
    const hardenedPayloads = [
      // Quoted env assignments & +=

      `env FOO="bar" sh -c '$(whoami)'`,

      `bash -oo pipefail noglob -c '$(whoami)'`,
      // POSIX unquoted escaped literal backslash followed by shell metacharacters
      'sh -e -c true\\ a\\\\b\\;\\$\\(whoami\\)',
      // Bash locale-translated double quotes ($"...")
      `sh -$"c" '$(whoami)'`,

      `timeout -fs KILL 5 sh -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `sudo -Eu root sh -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `watch -xn 1 sh -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `echo x | xargs sh -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `echo x | xargs -0 -I {} sh -c '$(whoami)'`,
      'env -S "sh\\_-c\\_\'\\$(whoami)\'"',
      // Clobber redirection >|
      `sh -c >| /dev/null '$(whoami)'`,
      `sh -c >|/dev/null '$(whoami)'`,
      // Windows / PowerShell / .exe / fish edge cases
      `pwsh -c 'Write-Host' '$(Get-Process)'`,
      `pwsh -c '' '$(Get-Process)'`,
      `pwsh -c \u2018$(Get-Process)\u2019`,
      `powershell.exe /c '$(Get-Process)'`,
      `powershell.exe '$(Get-Process)'`,
      `powershell.exe -NoProfile '$(Get-Process)'`,
      'pwsh -enc "JAAoAHcA\n aABvAGEAbQBpACkA"',
      `pwsh -enc ${'A'.repeat(70_000)}`,
      `bash.exe -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `sh.exe -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `fish -c '$(whoami)'`,
      `fish -C '$(whoami)'`,
    ];

    for (const cmd of hardenedPayloads) {
      expect(
        detectCommandSubstitution(cmd),
        `detectCommandSubstitution(${cmd.slice(0, 80)})`,
      ).toBe(true);
      expect(
        detectCommandSubstitution(stripShellWrapper(cmd)),
        `detectCommandSubstitution(stripShellWrapper(${cmd.slice(0, 80)}))`,
      ).toBe(true);
    }

    // PowerShell -File and single .ps1 path should not be flagged as substitution.
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('powershell.exe -File ./script.ps1')).toBe(
      false,
    );
    expect(detectCommandSubstitution('powershell.exe ./script.ps1')).toBe(
      false,
    );
  });
});

/**
 * Extracts the primary command name from a potentially wrapped shell command.
 * Strips shell wrappers and handles shopt/set/etc.
 *
 * @param command - The full command string.
 * @param args - The arguments for the command.
 * @returns The primary command name.
 */
export async function getCommandName(
  command: string,
  args: string[],
): Promise<string> {
  await initializeShellParsers();
  const fullCmd = [command, ...args].join(' ');
  const stripped = stripShellWrapper(fullCmd);
  const roots = (await getCommandRootsAsync(stripped)).filter(
    (r) => r !== 'shopt' && r !== 'set',
  );
  if (roots.length > 0) {
    return roots[0];
  }
  return path.basename(command);
}

/**
 * Extracts a string representation from a shell-quote ParseEntry.
 */
export function extractStringFromParseEntry(entry: ParseEntry): string {
  if (typeof entry === 'string') return entry;
  if ('pattern' in entry) return entry.pattern;
  if ('op' in entry) return entry.op;
  if ('comment' in entry) return ''; // We can typically ignore comments for safety checks
  return '';
}

/**
 * An identifier for the shell type.
 */
export type ShellType = 'cmd' | 'powershell' | 'bash';

/**
 * Defines the configuration required to execute a command string within a specific shell.
 */
export interface ShellConfiguration {
  /** The path or name of the shell executable (e.g., 'bash', 'powershell.exe'). */
  executable: string;
  /**
   * The arguments required by the shell to execute a subsequent string argument.
   */
  argsPrefix: string[];
  /** An identifier for the shell type. */
  shell: ShellType;
}

function isExecutable(filePath: string): boolean {
  try {
    fs.accessSync(filePath, fs.constants.X_OK);
    return true;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

export function resolveExecutable(exe: string): string | undefined {
  if (path.isAbsolute(exe)) {
    return isExecutable(exe) ? exe : undefined;
  }
  const pathEnv = process.env['PATH'];
  if (!pathEnv) {
    return undefined;
  }
  const extensions =
    os.platform() === 'win32' ? ['.exe', '.cmd', '.bat', ''] : [''];
  for (const dir of pathEnv.split(path.delimiter)) {
    for (const ext of extensions) {
      const fullPath = path.join(dir, exe + ext);
      if (isExecutable(fullPath)) {
        return fullPath;
      }
    }
  }
  return undefined;
}

let bashLanguage: Language | null = null;
let treeSitterInitialization: Promise<void> | null = null;
let treeSitterInitializationError: Error | null = null;

class ShellParserInitializationError extends Error {
  constructor(cause: Error) {
    super(`Failed to initialize bash parser: ${cause.message}`, { cause });
    this.name = 'ShellParserInitializationError';
  }
}

function toError(value: unknown): Error {
  if (value instanceof Error) {
    return value;
  }
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    return new Error(value);
  }
  return new Error('Unknown tree-sitter initialization error', {
    cause: value,
  });
}

async function loadBashLanguage(): Promise<void> {
  try {
    treeSitterInitializationError = null;
    const [treeSitterBinary, bashBinary] = await Promise.all([
      loadWasmBinary(
        () =>
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
          // @ts-ignore resolved by esbuild-plugin-wasm during bundling
          import('web-tree-sitter/tree-sitter.wasm?binary'),
        'web-tree-sitter/tree-sitter.wasm',
      ),
      loadWasmBinary(
        () =>
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
          // @ts-ignore resolved by esbuild-plugin-wasm during bundling
          import('tree-sitter-bash/tree-sitter-bash.wasm?binary'),
        'tree-sitter-bash/tree-sitter-bash.wasm',
      ),
    ]);

    await Parser.init({ wasmBinary: treeSitterBinary });
    bashLanguage = await Language.load(bashBinary);
  } catch (error) {
    bashLanguage = null;
    const normalized = toError(error);
    const initializationError =
      normalized instanceof ShellParserInitializationError
        ? normalized
        : new ShellParserInitializationError(normalized);
    treeSitterInitializationError = initializationError;
    throw initializationError;
  }
}

export async function initializeShellParsers(): Promise<void> {
  if (!treeSitterInitialization) {
    treeSitterInitialization = loadBashLanguage().catch((error) => {
      treeSitterInitialization = null;
      // Log the error but don't throw, allowing the application to fall back to safe defaults (ASK_USER)
      // or regex checks where appropriate.
      debugLogger.debug('Failed to initialize shell parsers:', error);
    });
  }

  await treeSitterInitialization;
}

const POWERSHELL_COMMAND_ENV = '__GCLI_POWERSHELL_COMMAND__';
const PARSE_TIMEOUT_MICROS = 1000 * 1000; // 1 second

// Encode the parser script as UTF-16LE base64 so we can pass it via PowerShell's -EncodedCommand flag;
// this avoids brittle quoting/escaping when spawning PowerShell and ensures the script is received byte-for-byte.
const POWERSHELL_PARSER_SCRIPT = Buffer.from(
  `
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$commandText = $env:${POWERSHELL_COMMAND_ENV}
if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($commandText)) {
  Write-Output '{"success":false}'
  exit 0
}
$tokens = $null
$errors = $null
$ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput($commandText, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$errors)
if ($errors -and $errors.Count -gt 0) {
  Write-Output '{"success":false}'
  exit 0
}
$commandAsts = $ast.FindAll({ param($node) $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.CommandAst] }, $true)
$commandObjects = @()
$hasRedirection = $false
foreach ($commandAst in $commandAsts) {
  if ($commandAst.Redirections.Count -gt 0) {
    $hasRedirection = $true
  }
  $name = $commandAst.GetCommandName()
  if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($name)) {
    continue
  }
  $cmdArgs = @()
  if ($commandAst.CommandElements.Count -gt 1) {
    for ($i = 1; $i -lt $commandAst.CommandElements.Count; $i++) {
      $cmdArgs += $commandAst.CommandElements[$i].Extent.Text.Trim()
    }
  }
  $commandObjects += [PSCustomObject]@{
    name = $name
    text = $commandAst.Extent.Text.Trim()
    startIndex = $commandAst.Extent.StartOffset
    args = @($cmdArgs)
  }
}
$staticInvocations = $ast.FindAll({
  param($node)
  $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.InvokeMemberExpressionAst] -and (
    $node.Expression -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.TypeExpressionAst] -or
    $node.Expression -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ScriptBlockExpressionAst] -or
    $node.Expression -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ConvertExpressionAst] -or (
      $node.Expression -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ParenExpressionAst] -and
      $node.Expression.Pipeline.FindAll({
        param($inner)
        $inner -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ConvertExpressionAst] -or
        $inner -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ScriptBlockExpressionAst]
      }, $true).Count -gt 0
    )
  )
}, $true)
foreach ($invokeAst in $staticInvocations) {
  $invokeText = $invokeAst.Extent.Text.Trim()
  $commandObjects += [PSCustomObject]@{
    name = $invokeText
    text = $invokeText
    startIndex = $invokeAst.Extent.StartOffset
    args = @()
  }
}
$hasSubExpr = $ast.FindAll({
  param($node)
  $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.SubExpressionAst] -or
  $node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ArrayExpressionAst] -or
  ($node -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.ParenExpressionAst] -and
   $node.Pipeline.FindAll({ param($p) $p -is [System.Management.Automation.Language.CommandAst] }, $false).Count -gt 0)
}, $true).Count -gt 0
[PSCustomObject]@{
  success = $true
  commands = @($commandObjects)
  hasRedirection = $hasRedirection
  hasCommandSubstitution = $hasSubExpr
} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress -Depth 4
`,
  'utf16le',
).toString('base64');

export const REDIRECTION_NAMES = new Set([
  'redirection (<)',
  'redirection (>)',
  'heredoc (<<)',
  'herestring (<<<)',
  'command substitution',
  'backtick substitution',
  'process substitution',
  'subshell',
]);

function createParser(): Parser | null {
  if (!bashLanguage) {
    if (treeSitterInitializationError) {
      throw treeSitterInitializationError;
    }
    return null;
  }

  try {
    const parser = new Parser();
    parser.setLanguage(bashLanguage);
    return parser;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function parseCommandTree(
  command: string,
  timeoutMicros: number = PARSE_TIMEOUT_MICROS,
): Tree | null {
  const parser = createParser();
  if (!parser || !command.trim()) {
    return null;
  }

  const deadline = performance.now() + timeoutMicros / 1000;
  let timedOut = false;

  try {
    const tree = parser.parse(command, null, {
      progressCallback: () => {
        if (performance.now() > deadline) {
          timedOut = true;
          // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-type-assertion
          return true as unknown as void; // Returning true cancels parsing, but type says void
        }
      },
    });

    if (timedOut) {
      debugLogger.error('Bash command parsing timed out for command:', command);
      // Returning a partial tree could be risky so we return null to be safe.
      return null;
    }

    return tree;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function normalizeCommandName(raw: string): string {
  if (raw.length >= 2) {
    const first = raw[0];
    const last = raw[raw.length - 1];
    if ((first === '"' && last === '"') || (first === "'" && last === "'")) {
      return raw.slice(1, -1);
    }
  }
  return raw.trim();
}

/**
 * Normalizes a command name for sandbox policy lookups.
 * Converts to lowercase and removes the .exe extension for cross-platform consistency.
 *
 * @param commandName - The command name to normalize.
 * @returns The normalized command name.
 */
export function normalizeCommand(commandName: string): string {
  // Split by both separators and get the last non-empty part
  const parts = commandName.split(/[\\/]/).filter(Boolean);
  const base = parts.length > 0 ? parts[parts.length - 1] : '';
  return base.toLowerCase().replace(/\.exe$/, '');
}

function extractNameFromNode(node: Node): string | null {
  switch (node.type) {
    case 'command': {
      const nameNode = node.childForFieldName('name');
      if (!nameNode) {
        return null;
      }
      return normalizeCommandName(nameNode.text);
    }
    case 'declaration_command':
    case 'unset_command':
    case 'test_command': {
      const firstChild = node.child(0);
      if (!firstChild) {
        return null;
      }
      return normalizeCommandName(firstChild.text);
    }
    case 'file_redirect': {
      // The first child might be a file descriptor (e.g., '2>').
      // We iterate to find the actual operator token.
      for (let i = 0; i < node.childCount; i++) {
        const child = node.child(i);
        if (child && child.text.includes('<')) {
          return 'redirection (<)';
        }
        if (child && child.text.includes('>')) {
          return 'redirection (>)';
        }
      }
      return 'redirection (>)';
    }
    case 'heredoc_redirect':
      return 'heredoc (<<)';
    case 'herestring_redirect':
      return 'herestring (<<<)';
    case 'command_substitution':
      return 'command substitution';
    case 'backtick_substitution':
      return 'backtick substitution';
    case 'process_substitution':
      return 'process substitution';
    case 'subshell':
      return 'subshell';
    default:
      return null;
  }
}

function collectCommandDetails(
  root: Node,
  source: string,
): ParsedCommandDetail[] {
  const stack: Node[] = [root];
  const details: ParsedCommandDetail[] = [];

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const current = stack.pop()!;

    const name = extractNameFromNode(current);
    if (name) {
      const detail: ParsedCommandDetail = {
        name,
        text: source.slice(current.startIndex, current.endIndex).trim(),
        startIndex: current.startIndex,
      };

      if (current.type === 'command') {
        const args: string[] = [];
        const nameNode = current.childForFieldName('name');
        for (let i = 0; i < current.childCount; i += 1) {
          const child = current.child(i);
          if (
            child &&
            child.type === 'word' &&
            child.startIndex !== nameNode?.startIndex
          ) {
            args.push(child.text);
          }
        }
        if (args.length > 0) {
          detail.args = args;
        }
      }

      details.push(detail);
    }

    // Traverse all children to find all sub-components (commands, redirections, etc.)
    for (let i = current.childCount - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      const child = current.child(i);
      if (child) {
        stack.push(child);
      }
    }
  }

  return details;
}

function hasPromptCommandTransform(root: Node): boolean {
  const stack: Node[] = [root];

  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const current = stack.pop();
    if (!current) {
      continue;
    }

    if (current.type === 'expansion') {
      for (let i = 0; i < current.childCount - 1; i += 1) {
        const operatorNode = current.child(i);
        const transformNode = current.child(i + 1);

        if (
          operatorNode?.text === '@' &&
          transformNode?.text?.toLowerCase() === 'p'
        ) {
          return true;
        }
      }
    }

    for (let i = current.namedChildCount - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      const child = current.namedChild(i);
      if (child) {
        stack.push(child);
      }
    }
  }

  return false;
}

export function parseBashCommandDetails(
  command: string,
): CommandParseResult | null {
  if (treeSitterInitializationError) {
    debugLogger.debug(
      'Bash parser not initialized:',
      treeSitterInitializationError,
    );
    return null;
  }

  if (!bashLanguage) {
    initializeShellParsers().catch(() => {
      // The failure path is surfaced via treeSitterInitializationError.
    });
    return null;
  }

  const tree = parseCommandTree(command);
  if (!tree) {
    return null;
  }

  const details = collectCommandDetails(tree.rootNode, command);

  const hasError =
    tree.rootNode.hasError ||
    details.length === 0 ||
    hasPromptCommandTransform(tree.rootNode);

  if (hasError) {
    let query = null;
    try {
      query = new Query(bashLanguage, '(ERROR) @error (MISSING) @missing');
      const captures = query.captures(tree.rootNode);
      const syntaxErrors = captures.map((capture) => {
        const { node, name } = capture;
        const type = name === 'missing' ? 'Missing' : 'Error';
        return `${type} node: "${node.text}" at ${node.startPosition.row}:${node.startPosition.column}`;
      });

      debugLogger.log(
        'Bash command parsing error detected for command:',
        command,
        'Syntax Errors:',
        syntaxErrors,
      );
    } catch {
      // Ignore query errors
    } finally {
      query?.delete();
    }
  }
  return {
    details: details.sort((a, b) => a.startIndex - b.startIndex),
    hasError,
  };
}

interface RawPowerShellCommand {
  name?: unknown;
  text?: unknown;
  startIndex?: unknown;
  args?: unknown;
}

interface RawPowerShellParsePayload {
  success?: unknown;
  commands?: unknown;
  hasRedirection?: unknown;
  hasCommandSubstitution?: unknown;
}

function isRawPowerShellCommand(value: unknown): value is RawPowerShellCommand {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function isRawPowerShellParsePayload(
  value: unknown,
): value is RawPowerShellParsePayload {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function parsePowerShellParserOutput(
  rawStdout: string,
  originalCommand: string,
): CommandParseResult {
  const output = rawStdout.trim();
  if (!output) {
    return { details: [], hasError: true };
  }

  let parsedUnknown: unknown;
  try {
    parsedUnknown = JSON.parse(output);
  } catch {
    return { details: [], hasError: true };
  }

  if (
    !isRawPowerShellParsePayload(parsedUnknown) ||
    parsedUnknown.success !== true
  ) {
    return { details: [], hasError: true };
  }

  const rawCommandsField = parsedUnknown.commands;
  const rawCommands: unknown[] = Array.isArray(rawCommandsField)
    ? rawCommandsField
    : isRawPowerShellCommand(rawCommandsField)
      ? [rawCommandsField]
      : [];

  const details = rawCommands
    .map((commandDetail): ParsedCommandDetail | null => {
      if (
        !isRawPowerShellCommand(commandDetail) ||
        typeof commandDetail.name !== 'string'
      ) {
        return null;
      }

      const name = normalizeCommandName(commandDetail.name);
      const text =
        typeof commandDetail.text === 'string'
          ? commandDetail.text.trim()
          : originalCommand;
      const rawArgs = commandDetail.args;

      return {
        name,
        text,
        startIndex:
          typeof commandDetail.startIndex === 'number'
            ? commandDetail.startIndex
            : 0,
        args: Array.isArray(rawArgs)
          ? rawArgs.filter((arg): arg is string => typeof arg === 'string')
          : undefined,
      };
    })
    .filter((detail): detail is ParsedCommandDetail => detail !== null)
    .sort((a, b) => a.startIndex - b.startIndex);

  return {
    details,
    hasError: details.length === 0,
    hasRedirection:
      typeof parsedUnknown.hasRedirection === 'boolean'
        ? parsedUnknown.hasRedirection
        : undefined,
    hasCommandSubstitution:
      typeof parsedUnknown.hasCommandSubstitution === 'boolean'
        ? parsedUnknown.hasCommandSubstitution
        : false,
  };
}

// Coalesces strictly concurrent in-flight async PowerShell AST parses across
// callers (e.g. Scheduler validation and UI turn-activity hooks) and removes
// entries immediately on completion so no process-wide parse state is retained.
const globalInFlightPowerShellParses = new Map<
  string,
  Promise<CommandParseResult | null>
>();

function parsePowerShellCommandDetails(
  command: string,
  executable: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
): CommandParseResult | null {
  const trimmed = command.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return {
      details: [],
      hasError: true,
    };
  }

  const activeCache = cache ?? getActiveCommandParseCache();
  if (activeCache?.hasCompleted(executable, command)) {
    return activeCache.getCompleted(executable, command) ?? null;
  }

  try {
    const result = spawnSync(
      executable,
      [
        '-NoLogo',
        '-NoProfile',
        '-NonInteractive',
        '-EncodedCommand',
        POWERSHELL_PARSER_SCRIPT,
      ],
      {
        env: {
          ...process.env,
          [POWERSHELL_COMMAND_ENV]: command,
        },
        encoding: 'utf-8',
      },
    );

    if (result.error || result.status !== 0) {
      activeCache?.setCompleted(executable, command, null);
      return null;
    }

    const parsed = parsePowerShellParserOutput(
      (result.stdout ?? '').toString(),
      command,
    );
    activeCache?.setCompleted(executable, command, parsed);
    return parsed;
  } catch {
    activeCache?.setCompleted(executable, command, null);
    return null;
  }
}

async function parsePowerShellCommandDetailsAsync(
  command: string,
  executable: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<CommandParseResult | null> {
  const trimmed = command.trim();
  if (!trimmed) {
    return {
      details: [],
      hasError: true,
    };
  }

  if (signal?.aborted) {
    return null;
  }

  const activeCache = cache ?? getActiveCommandParseCache();
  if (activeCache?.hasCompleted(executable, command)) {
    return activeCache.getCompleted(executable, command) ?? null;
  }

  const existingInFlight = activeCache?.getInFlight(executable, command);
  if (existingInFlight) {
    return existingInFlight;
  }

  const globalKey = `${executable}\0${command}`;
  if (!signal) {
    const existingGlobalInFlight =
      globalInFlightPowerShellParses.get(globalKey);
    if (existingGlobalInFlight) {
      const joinedPromise = existingGlobalInFlight.then((result) => {
        activeCache?.setCompleted(executable, command, result);
        return result;
      });
      if (activeCache) {
        return activeCache.trackInFlight(executable, command, joinedPromise);
      }
      return joinedPromise;
    }
  }

  const parsePromise = new Promise<CommandParseResult | null>((resolve) => {
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (value: CommandParseResult | null, cacheResult = true) => {
      if (!settled) {
        settled = true;
        if (cacheResult && !signal?.aborted) {
          activeCache?.setCompleted(executable, command, value);
        }
        resolve(value);
      }
    };

    let child;
    try {
      child = spawn(
        executable,
        [
          '-NoLogo',
          '-NoProfile',
          '-NonInteractive',
          '-EncodedCommand',
          POWERSHELL_PARSER_SCRIPT,
        ],
        {
          env: {
            ...process.env,
            [POWERSHELL_COMMAND_ENV]: command,
          },
          stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
          windowsHide: true,
          ...(signal ? { signal } : {}),
        },
      );
    } catch {
      finish(null, !signal?.aborted);
      return;
    }

    let stdout = '';
    child.stdout?.setEncoding('utf-8');
    child.stdout?.on('data', (chunk: string | Buffer) => {
      stdout += chunk.toString();
    });
    child.stderr?.on('data', () => {
      // Drain stderr to avoid blocking child exit if diagnostics are written.
    });
    child.on('error', (err) => {
      if (err.name === 'AbortError' || signal?.aborted) {
        finish(null, false);
        return;
      }
      finish(null);
    });
    child.on('close', (code) => {
      if (signal?.aborted) {
        finish(null, false);
        return;
      }
      if (code !== 0) {
        finish(null);
        return;
      }
      const parsed = parsePowerShellParserOutput(stdout, command);
      finish(parsed);
    });
  });

  if (!signal) {
    globalInFlightPowerShellParses.set(globalKey, parsePromise);
    void parsePromise.finally(() => {
      if (globalInFlightPowerShellParses.get(globalKey) === parsePromise) {
        globalInFlightPowerShellParses.delete(globalKey);
      }
    });
  }

  if (activeCache) {
    return activeCache.trackInFlight(executable, command, parsePromise);
  }
  return parsePromise;
}

export function parseCommandDetails(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
): CommandParseResult | null {
  const configuration = getShellConfiguration();

  if (configuration.shell === 'powershell') {
    const result = parsePowerShellCommandDetails(
      command,
      configuration.executable,
      cache,
    );
    if (!result || result.hasError) {
      // Never fall back to the Bash parser when PowerShell command substitution
      // is detected, because Bash and PowerShell have incompatible quoting,
      // escaping, and subexpression grammars (e.g. @(...), bare (...)
      // subexpressions, backtick escapes, and Unicode quotes).
      if (detectPowerShellSubstitution(command)) {
        return result ?? { details: [], hasError: true };
      }
      // Fallback to bash parser which is usually good enough for simple commands
      // and doesn't rely on the host PowerShell environment restrictions (e.g., ConstrainedLanguage)
      const bashResult = parseBashCommandDetails(command);
      if (bashResult && !bashResult.hasError) {
        return bashResult;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  if (configuration.shell === 'bash') {
    return parseBashCommandDetails(command);
  }

  return null;
}

export async function parseCommandDetailsAsync(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<CommandParseResult | null> {
  if (signal?.aborted) {
    return null;
  }

  const configuration = getShellConfiguration();

  if (configuration.shell === 'powershell') {
    const result = await parsePowerShellCommandDetailsAsync(
      command,
      configuration.executable,
      cache,
      signal,
    );
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      return null;
    }
    if (!result || result.hasError) {
      if (detectPowerShellSubstitution(command)) {
        return result ?? { details: [], hasError: true };
      }
      await initializeShellParsers();
      const bashResult = parseBashCommandDetails(command);
      if (bashResult && !bashResult.hasError) {
        return bashResult;
      }
    }
    return result;
  }

  if (configuration.shell === 'bash') {
    await initializeShellParsers();
    return parseBashCommandDetails(command);
  }

  return null;
}

const defaultParseCommandDetailsRef = parseCommandDetails;

export function isDefaultParseCommandDetails(fn: unknown): boolean {
  return fn === defaultParseCommandDetailsRef;
}

/**
 * Determines the appropriate shell configuration for the current platform.
 *
 * This ensures we can execute command strings predictably and securely across platforms
 * using the `spawn(executable, [...argsPrefix, commandString], { shell: false })` pattern.
 *
 * On Windows, PowerShell 7 (pwsh.exe) is preferred over Windows PowerShell 5.1
 * (powershell.exe) when available on PATH. Windows PowerShell 5.1 silently
 * strips embedded double quotes from arguments to native executables — see
 * issue #25859. PowerShell 7 uses standards-compliant argument passing and
 * does not exhibit this regression. When pwsh.exe is not installed, we fall
 * back to powershell.exe to preserve the existing behavior and the full
 * cmdlet surface users depend on.
 *
 * @returns The ShellConfiguration for the current environment.
 */
export function getShellConfiguration(): ShellConfiguration {
  if (isWindows()) {
    // -NonInteractive prevents PSReadLine from intercepting console input
    // events inside the ConPTY session, which otherwise causes interactive
    // TUI tools (e.g. pnpm create vite, vim) to receive malformed key events
    // and exit when arrow keys are pressed.
    const powershellArgsPrefix = ['-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command'];
    const comSpec = process.env['ComSpec'];
    if (comSpec) {
      const executable = comSpec.toLowerCase();
      if (
        executable.endsWith('powershell.exe') ||
        executable.endsWith('pwsh.exe')
      ) {
        return {
          executable: comSpec,
          argsPrefix: powershellArgsPrefix,
          shell: 'powershell',
        };
      }
    }

    const pwshPath = resolveExecutable('pwsh.exe');
    if (pwshPath) {
      return {
        executable: pwshPath,
        argsPrefix: powershellArgsPrefix,
        shell: 'powershell',
      };
    }

    // Fall back to Windows PowerShell 5.1 when pwsh.exe is not installed.
    return {
      executable: 'powershell.exe',
      argsPrefix: powershellArgsPrefix,
      shell: 'powershell',
    };
  }

  // Unix-like systems (Linux, macOS)
  return { executable: 'bash', argsPrefix: ['-c'], shell: 'bash' };
}

/**
 * Export the platform detection constant for use in process management (e.g., killing processes).
 */
export const isWindows = () => os.platform() === 'win32';

/**
 * Escapes a string so that it can be safely used as a single argument
 * in a shell command, preventing command injection.
 *
 * @param arg The argument string to escape.
 * @param shell The type of shell the argument is for.
 * @returns The shell-escaped string.
 */
export function escapeShellArg(arg: string, shell: ShellType): string {
  if (!arg) {
    return '';
  }

  switch (shell) {
    case 'powershell':
      // For PowerShell, avoid quoting simple alphanumeric strings (like UUIDs).
      if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_.]+$/.test(arg)) {
        return arg;
      }
      // Otherwise, wrap in single quotes and escape internal single quotes by doubling them.
      return `'${arg.replace(/'/g, "''")}'`;
    case 'cmd':
      // Avoid quoting simple strings for cmd.exe as well.
      if (/^[a-zA-Z0-9\-_.]+$/.test(arg)) {
        return arg;
      }
      // Simple Windows escaping for cmd.exe: wrap in double quotes and escape inner double quotes.
      return `"${arg.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    case 'bash':
    default:
      // POSIX shell escaping using shell-quote.
      return quote([arg]);
  }
}

/**
 * Splits a shell command into a list of individual commands, respecting quotes.
 * This is used to separate chained commands (e.g., using &&, ||, ;).
 * @param command The shell command string to parse
 * @returns An array of individual command strings
 */
/**
 * Checks if a command contains redirection operators.
 * Uses shell-specific parsers where possible, falling back to a broad regex check.
 */
function hasBashTreeRedirection(
  command: string,
  fallbackCheck: () => boolean,
): boolean {
  const tree = parseCommandTree(command);
  if (!tree) return fallbackCheck();

  const stack: Node[] = [tree.rootNode];
  while (stack.length > 0) {
    const current = stack.pop()!;
    if (
      current.type === 'redirected_statement' ||
      current.type === 'file_redirect' ||
      current.type === 'heredoc_redirect' ||
      current.type === 'herestring_redirect'
    ) {
      return true;
    }
    for (let i = current.childCount - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
      const child = current.child(i);
      if (child) stack.push(child);
    }
  }
  return false;
}

export function hasRedirection(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
): boolean {
  const fallbackCheck = () => /[><]/.test(command);

  // If there are no redirection characters at all, we can skip parsing.
  if (!fallbackCheck()) {
    return false;
  }

  const configuration = getShellConfiguration();

  if (configuration.shell === 'powershell') {
    const parsed = parsePowerShellCommandDetails(
      command,
      configuration.executable,
      cache,
    );
    return parsed && !parsed.hasError
      ? !!parsed.hasRedirection
      : fallbackCheck();
  }

  if (configuration.shell === 'bash' && bashLanguage) {
    return hasBashTreeRedirection(command, fallbackCheck);
  }

  return fallbackCheck();
}

export async function hasRedirectionAsync(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (signal?.aborted) {
    return false;
  }

  const fallbackCheck = () => /[><]/.test(command);

  if (!fallbackCheck()) {
    return false;
  }

  const configuration = getShellConfiguration();

  if (configuration.shell === 'powershell') {
    const parsed = await parsePowerShellCommandDetailsAsync(
      command,
      configuration.executable,
      cache,
      signal,
    );
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      return false;
    }
    return parsed && !parsed.hasError
      ? !!parsed.hasRedirection
      : fallbackCheck();
  }

  if (configuration.shell === 'bash') {
    await initializeShellParsers();
    if (bashLanguage) {
      return hasBashTreeRedirection(command, fallbackCheck);
    }
  }

  return fallbackCheck();
}

/**
 * Syntax tree node types whose value bash computes when the command runs:
 * parameter and variable expansion, ANSI-C quoting, arithmetic expansion,
 * command and process substitution, and brace sequence expressions.
 */
const SHELL_EXPANSION_NODE_TYPES = new Set([
  'simple_expansion',
  'expansion',
  'ansi_c_string',
  'arithmetic_expansion',
  'command_substitution',
  'process_substitution',
  'brace_expression',
]);

/**
 * Returns the text of a `word` or `concatenation` node with every quoted part
 * replaced by a placeholder, because quoted text is never globbed or brace
 * expanded.
 */
function getUnquotedWordText(node: Node): string {
  if (node.type !== 'concatenation') {
    return node.text;
  }
  let text = '';
  for (let i = 0; i < node.childCount; i += 1) {
    const child = node.child(i);
    if (!child) {
      continue;
    }
    const isQuoted =
      child.type === 'raw_string' ||
      child.type === 'string' ||
      child.type === 'ansi_c_string';
    text += isQuoted ? '_' : child.text;
  }
  return text;
}

/**
 * Checks unquoted word text for syntax that bash and the `shell-quote`
 * tokenizer read differently: glob patterns (`*`, `?`, `[...]`), brace groups
 * that contain a `,` or `..` at their own nesting level (such as `{a,b}` or
 * `{a..c}`), and a `#` inside a word. Bash keeps a `#` that doesn't start a
 * word as a literal character, but `shell-quote` starts a comment there and
 * drops the rest of the command. Backslash-escaped characters are literal.
 */
function hasUnquotedWordSyntax(text: string): boolean {
  let hasOpenBracket = false;
  // One entry per open brace group: whether it contains a separator.
  const braceGroups: boolean[] = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i += 1) {
    const char = text[i];
    if (char === '\\') {
      i += 1;
    } else if (char === '*' || char === '?' || (char === '#' && i > 0)) {
      return true;
    } else if (char === '[') {
      hasOpenBracket = true;
    } else if (char === ']' && hasOpenBracket) {
      return true;
    } else if (char === '{') {
      braceGroups.push(false);
    } else if (char === '}' && braceGroups.length > 0) {
      if (braceGroups.pop()) {
        return true;
      }
    } else if (
      braceGroups.length > 0 &&
      (char === ',' || (char === '.' && text[i + 1] === '.'))
    ) {
      braceGroups[braceGroups.length - 1] = true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

const WHITESPACE = /\s/;

/**
 * Checks for a backslash-newline line continuation that changes an argument.
 * Bash removes the pair before it splits words, so `-ex\<newline>ec` runs as
 * `-exec`, and the pair is also removed inside double quotes. A continuation
 * between two separate words (whitespace on either side) doesn't change any
 * argument. Continuations inside single quotes or comments are literal.
 */
function hasArgumentLineContinuation(root: Node, command: string): boolean {
  for (
    let newline = command.indexOf('\n');
    newline !== -1;
    newline = command.indexOf('\n', newline + 1)
  ) {
    const end = command[newline - 1] === '\r' ? newline - 1 : newline;
    let backslashes = 0;
    while (command[end - 1 - backslashes] === '\\') {
      backslashes += 1;
    }
    if (backslashes % 2 === 0) {
      continue;
    }

    const backslash = end - 1;
    let isQuoted = false;
    let isLiteral = false;
    for (
      let node = root.descendantForIndex(backslash, backslash + 1);
      node;
      node = node.parent
    ) {
      if (node.type === 'raw_string' || node.type === 'comment') {
        isLiteral = true;
        break;
      }
      if (node.type === 'string') {
        isQuoted = true;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (isLiteral) {
      continue;
    }

    const before = command[backslash - 1];
    const after = command[newline + 1];
    const joinsWords =
      before !== undefined &&
      !WHITESPACE.test(before) &&
      after !== undefined &&
      !WHITESPACE.test(after);
    if (isQuoted || joinsWords) {
      return true;
    }
  }
  return false;
}

/**
 * Checks whether bash would rewrite the arguments of a command before running
 * it, so the unexpanded text doesn't describe what runs. This covers brace
 * expansion, parameter and variable expansion, ANSI-C (`$'...'`) and locale
 * (`$"..."`) quoting, arithmetic expansion, command and process substitution,
 * unquoted glob patterns, line continuations inside an argument, and a `#`
 * inside an unquoted word. Tilde expansion isn't reported.
 *
 * Returns `true` when the command can't be parsed (parser unavailable, parse
 * timeout, or syntax errors), and `false` when the configured shell isn't
 * bash.
 */
export function hasUnresolvedShellExpansion(command: string): boolean {
  if (getShellConfiguration().shell !== 'bash') {
    return false;
  }
  if (!bashLanguage) {
    return true;
  }

  const tree = parseCommandTree(command);
  if (!tree) {
    return true;
  }

  try {
    if (tree.rootNode.hasError) {
      return true;
    }

    if (hasArgumentLineContinuation(tree.rootNode, command)) {
      return true;
    }

    const stack: Node[] = [tree.rootNode];
    while (stack.length > 0) {
      const current = stack.pop()!;

      // Single-quoted text never expands.
      if (current.type === 'raw_string') {
        continue;
      }

      if (SHELL_EXPANSION_NODE_TYPES.has(current.type)) {
        return true;
      }

      if (current.type === 'string') {
        // tree-sitter-bash parses locale quoting (`$"..."`) as a `$` token
        // directly followed by a `string` node. Inside double quotes, only
        // the `$` forms above expand, and they're checked as child nodes.
        const previous = current.previousSibling;
        if (
          previous?.type === '$' &&
          previous.endIndex === current.startIndex
        ) {
          return true;
        }
      } else if (
        current.type === 'concatenation' ||
        (current.type === 'word' && current.parent?.type !== 'concatenation')
      ) {
        if (hasUnquotedWordSyntax(getUnquotedWordText(current))) {
          return true;
        }
      }

      for (let i = current.childCount - 1; i >= 0; i -= 1) {
        const child = current.child(i);
        if (child) {
          stack.push(child);
        }
      }
    }
    return false;
  } finally {
    tree.delete();
  }
}

export function splitCommands(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
): string[] {
  const parsed = parseCommandDetails(command, cache);
  if (!parsed || parsed.hasError) {
    return [];
  }

  return parsed.details
    .filter((detail) => !REDIRECTION_NAMES.has(detail.name))
    .map((detail) => detail.text)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export async function splitCommandsAsync(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<string[]> {
  const parsed = await parseCommandDetailsAsync(command, cache, signal);
  if (!parsed || parsed.hasError) {
    return [];
  }

  return parsed.details
    .filter((detail) => !REDIRECTION_NAMES.has(detail.name))
    .map((detail) => detail.text)
    .filter(Boolean);
}

/**
 * Extracts the root command from a given shell command string.
 * This is used to identify the base command for permission checks.
 * @param command The shell command string to parse
 * @returns The root command name, or undefined if it cannot be determined
 * @example getCommandRoot("ls -la /tmp") returns "ls"
 * @example getCommandRoot("git status && npm test") returns "git"
 */
export function getCommandRoot(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
): string | undefined {
  const parsed = parseCommandDetails(command, cache);
  if (!parsed || parsed.hasError || parsed.details.length === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return parsed.details[0]?.name;
}

export async function getCommandRootAsync(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<string | undefined> {
  const parsed = await parseCommandDetailsAsync(command, cache, signal);
  if (!parsed || parsed.hasError || parsed.details.length === 0) {
    return undefined;
  }

  return parsed.details[0]?.name;
}

export function getCommandRoots(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
): string[] {
  if (!command) {
    return [];
  }

  const parsed = parseCommandDetails(command, cache);
  if (!parsed || parsed.hasError) {
    return [];
  }

  return parsed.details
    .map((detail) => detail.name)
    .filter((name) => !REDIRECTION_NAMES.has(name))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

export async function getCommandRootsAsync(
  command: string,
  cache?: CommandParseCache,
  signal?: AbortSignal,
): Promise<string[]> {
  if (!command) {
    return [];
  }

  const parsed = await parseCommandDetailsAsync(command, cache, signal);
  if (!parsed || parsed.hasError) {
    return [];
  }

  return parsed.details
    .map((detail) => detail.name)
    .filter((name) => !REDIRECTION_NAMES.has(name))
    .filter(Boolean);
}

const defaultHasRedirectionRef = hasRedirection;
const defaultSplitCommandsRef = splitCommands;
const defaultGetCommandRootsRef = getCommandRoots;

export function isDefaultHasRedirection(fn: unknown): boolean {
  return fn === defaultHasRedirectionRef;
}

export function isDefaultSplitCommands(fn: unknown): boolean {
  return fn === defaultSplitCommandsRef;
}

export function isDefaultGetCommandRoots(fn: unknown): boolean {
  return fn === defaultGetCommandRootsRef;
}

const PS_WRAPPER_FLAGS = new Set([
  '-nologo',
  '-noprofile',
  '-noninteractive',
  '-nol',
  '-nop',
  '-noni',
]);

function unescapePowerShellBacktickChar(ch: string): string {
  switch (ch) {
    case '0':
      return '\0';
    case 'a':
      return '\x07';
    case 'b':
      return '\b';
    case 'f':
      return '\f';
    case 'n':
      return '\n';
    case 'r':
      return '\r';
    case 't':
      return '\t';
    case 'v':
      return '\v';
    default:
      return ch;
  }
}

function readWrapperToken(
  command: string,
  startIndex: number,
): { value: string; quoted: boolean; nextIndex: number } | null {
  let i = startIndex;
  while (i < command.length && /\s/.test(command[i])) {
    i++;
  }
  if (i >= command.length) {
    return null;
  }
  const quote = command[i];
  if (quote === '"' || quote === "'") {
    const closeIdx = command.indexOf(quote, i + 1);
    if (closeIdx === -1) {
      return null;
    }
    const afterQuote = closeIdx + 1;
    if (afterQuote < command.length && !/\s/.test(command[afterQuote])) {
      return null;
    }
    return {
      value: command.slice(i + 1, closeIdx),
      quoted: true,
      nextIndex: afterQuote,
    };
  }
  let end = i;
  while (end < command.length && !/\s/.test(command[end])) {
    end++;
  }
  return {
    value: command.slice(i, end),
    quoted: false,
    nextIndex: end,
  };
}

function unwrapCmdCommandArg(rawArg: string): string | null {
  if (rawArg.startsWith('"') && rawArg.endsWith('"')) {
    let out = '';
    let j = 1;
    const end = rawArg.length - 1;
    while (j < end) {
      const ch = rawArg[j];
      if (ch === '\\') {
        let bsEnd = j;
        while (bsEnd < end && rawArg[bsEnd] === '\\') {
          bsEnd++;
        }
        const bsCount = bsEnd - j;
        if (bsEnd === end) {
          if (bsCount % 2 === 1) {
            return null;
          }
          out += '\\'.repeat(bsCount / 2);
          j = bsEnd;
          break;
        }
        if (rawArg[bsEnd] === '"') {
          if (bsCount % 2 === 1) {
            out += '\\'.repeat((bsCount - 1) / 2) + '"';
            j = bsEnd + 1;
            continue;
          }
          if (bsEnd + 1 < end && rawArg[bsEnd + 1] === '"') {
            out += '\\'.repeat(bsCount / 2) + '"';
            j = bsEnd + 2;
            continue;
          }
          return null;
        }
        out += '\\'.repeat(bsCount);
        j = bsEnd;
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '"') {
        if (j + 1 < end && rawArg[j + 1] === '"') {
          out += '"';
          j += 2;
          continue;
        }
        return null;
      }
      out += ch;
      j++;
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (rawArg.startsWith("'")) {
    if (!rawArg.endsWith("'")) {
      return null;
    }
    const inner = rawArg.slice(1, -1);
    return inner.includes("'") ? null : inner;
  }

  return rawArg;
}

function unwrapPowerShellCommandArg(rawArg: string): string | null {
  if (rawArg.length >= 2 && isPowerShellSingleQuote(rawArg[0])) {
    if (!isPowerShellSingleQuote(rawArg[rawArg.length - 1])) {
      return null;
    }
    let out = '';
    let j = 1;
    const end = rawArg.length - 1;
    while (j < end) {
      if (isPowerShellSingleQuote(rawArg[j])) {
        if (j + 1 < end && isPowerShellSingleQuote(rawArg[j + 1])) {
          out += rawArg[j];
          j += 2;
          continue;
        }
        return null;
      }
      out += rawArg[j];
      j++;
    }
    return out;
  }

  if (
    rawArg.length >= 2 &&
    isPowerShellDoubleQuote(rawArg[0]) &&
    isPowerShellDoubleQuote(rawArg[rawArg.length - 1])
  ) {
    let outerHasSubExpression = false;
    let out = '';
    let j = 1;
    const end = rawArg.length - 1;
    while (j < end) {
      const ch = rawArg[j];
      if (ch === '\\') {
        let bsEnd = j;
        while (bsEnd < end && rawArg[bsEnd] === '\\') {
          bsEnd++;
        }
        const bsCount = bsEnd - j;
        if (bsEnd === end) {
          if (bsCount % 2 === 1) {
            return null;
          }
          out += '\\'.repeat(bsCount / 2);
          j = bsEnd;
          break;
        }
        if (isPowerShellDoubleQuote(rawArg[bsEnd])) {
          if (bsCount % 2 === 1) {
            out += '\\'.repeat((bsCount - 1) / 2) + '"';
            j = bsEnd + 1;
            continue;
          }
          if (bsEnd + 1 < end && isPowerShellDoubleQuote(rawArg[bsEnd + 1])) {
            out += '\\'.repeat(bsCount / 2) + '"';
            j = bsEnd + 2;
            continue;
          }
          return null;
        }
        out += '\\'.repeat(bsCount);
        j = bsEnd;
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '`') {
        if (j + 1 >= end) {
          return null;
        }
        out += unescapePowerShellBacktickChar(rawArg[j + 1]);
        j += 2;
        continue;
      }
      if (isPowerShellDoubleQuote(ch)) {
        if (j + 1 < end && isPowerShellDoubleQuote(rawArg[j + 1])) {
          out += '"';
          j += 2;
          continue;
        }
        return null;
      }
      if (ch === '$' && j + 1 < end && rawArg[j + 1] === '{') {
        const afterBrace = Math.min(
          skipPowerShellBracedVariable(rawArg, j),
          end,
        );
        out += rawArg.slice(j, afterBrace);
        j = afterBrace;
        continue;
      }
      if (ch === '$' && j + 1 < end && rawArg[j + 1] === '(') {
        outerHasSubExpression = true;
      }
      out += ch;
      j++;
    }
    if (outerHasSubExpression && !detectPowerShellSubstitution(out)) {
      return null;
    }
    return out;
  }

  return rawArg;
}

function stripSingleShellWrapper(command: string): string {
  const exeToken = readWrapperToken(command, 0);
  if (!exeToken) {
    return command.trim();
  }

  if (!exeToken.quoted && !exeToken.value.includes('\\')) {
    const posixBase = exeToken.value
      .slice(exeToken.value.lastIndexOf('/') + 1)
      .toLowerCase();
    if (posixBase === 'sh' || posixBase === 'bash' || posixBase === 'zsh') {
      const flagToken = readWrapperToken(command, exeToken.nextIndex);
      if (
        flagToken &&
        !flagToken.quoted &&
        flagToken.value.toLowerCase() === '-c' &&
        flagToken.nextIndex < command.length &&
        /\s/.test(command[flagToken.nextIndex])
      ) {
        const newCommand = command.substring(flagToken.nextIndex).trim();
        if (newCommand.length >= 2) {
          if (newCommand.startsWith('"')) {
            if (!newCommand.endsWith('"')) {
              return command.trim();
            }
            const outerHasSubstitution = detectBashSubstitution(newCommand);
            let unwrapped: string | null = null;
            try {
              const parsed = parse(newCommand, (key) => '$' + key);
              const firstEntry = parsed[0];
              if (parsed.length === 1 && typeof firstEntry === 'string') {
                unwrapped = firstEntry;
              } else if (parsed.length > 1) {
                return command.trim();
              }
            } catch {
              // Fall through to simple outer quote removal below.
            }
            const candidate = unwrapped ?? newCommand.slice(1, -1);
            if (outerHasSubstitution && !detectBashSubstitution(candidate)) {
              return command.trim();
            }
            return candidate;
          }
          if (newCommand.startsWith("'")) {
            if (!newCommand.endsWith("'")) {
              return command.trim();
            }
            const inner = newCommand.slice(1, -1);
            if (!inner.includes("'")) {
              return inner;
            }
            return command.trim();
          }
        }
        if (
          newCommand.startsWith('-') ||
          newCommand.startsWith('+') ||
          newCommand.startsWith("$'") ||
          newCommand.startsWith('$"') ||
          /^\d*[<>]/.test(newCommand)
        ) {
          return command.trim();
        }
        if (
          /['"\\]/.test(newCommand) &&
          !detectBashSubstitution(newCommand) &&
          extractWrappedShellCommands(command.trim()).some(
            (payload) =>
              payload.uninspectable ||
              detectCommandSubstitutionInternal(
                payload.command,
                payload.shell,
                1,
                new Set<string>(),
              ),
          )
        ) {
          return command.trim();
        }
        return newCommand;
      }
    }
  }

  const winBase = exeToken.value
    .slice(
      Math.max(
        exeToken.value.lastIndexOf('/'),
        exeToken.value.lastIndexOf('\\'),
      ) + 1,
    )
    .toLowerCase();

  if (winBase === 'cmd' || winBase === 'cmd.exe') {
    let cursor = exeToken.nextIndex;
    while (cursor < command.length) {
      const flagToken = readWrapperToken(command, cursor);
      if (!flagToken || flagToken.quoted) {
        break;
      }
      const lowerFlag = flagToken.value.toLowerCase();
      if (lowerFlag === '/d' || lowerFlag === '/s') {
        cursor = flagToken.nextIndex;
        continue;
      }
      if (
        lowerFlag === '/c' &&
        flagToken.nextIndex < command.length &&
        /\s/.test(command[flagToken.nextIndex])
      ) {
        const newCommand = command.substring(flagToken.nextIndex).trim();
        if (newCommand.length >= 2) {
          const unwrapped = unwrapCmdCommandArg(newCommand);
          return unwrapped === null ? command.trim() : unwrapped;
        }
        return newCommand;
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  if (
    winBase === 'powershell' ||
    winBase === 'powershell.exe' ||
    winBase === 'pwsh' ||
    winBase === 'pwsh.exe'
  ) {
    let cursor = exeToken.nextIndex;
    while (cursor < command.length) {
      const flagToken = readWrapperToken(command, cursor);
      if (!flagToken || flagToken.quoted) {
        break;
      }
      const lowerFlag = flagToken.value.toLowerCase();
      if (PS_WRAPPER_FLAGS.has(lowerFlag)) {
        cursor = flagToken.nextIndex;
        continue;
      }
      if (
        (lowerFlag === '-command' || lowerFlag === '-c') &&
        flagToken.nextIndex < command.length &&
        /\s/.test(command[flagToken.nextIndex])
      ) {
        const newCommand = command.substring(flagToken.nextIndex).trim();
        if (newCommand.length >= 2) {
          const unwrapped = unwrapPowerShellCommandArg(newCommand);
          return unwrapped === null ? command.trim() : unwrapped;
        }
        return newCommand;
      }
      break;
    }
  }

  return command.trim();
}
