/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2026 Google LLC
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

/**
 * Options for formatForSpeech().
 */
export interface FormatForSpeechOptions {
  /**
   * Maximum output length in characters before truncating.
   * @default 500
   */
  maxLength?: number;
  /**
   * Number of trailing path segments to keep when abbreviating absolute paths.
   * @default 3
   */
  pathDepth?: number;
  /**
   * Maximum number of characters in a JSON value before summarising it.
   * @default 80
   */
  jsonThreshold?: number;
}

// ANSI escape sequences (CSI, OSC, etc.)
// eslint-disable-next-line no-control-regex
const ANSI_RE = /\x1b(?:\[[0-9;]*[mGKHF]|\][^\x07\x1b]*\x07|[()][AB012])/g;

// Fenced code blocks  ```lang\n...\n```
const CODE_FENCE_RE = /```[^\n]*\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;

// Inline code  `...`
const INLINE_CODE_RE = /`([^`]+)`/g;

// Bold/italic markers  **text**, *text*, __text__, _text_
// Exclude newlines so the pattern cannot span multiple lines and accidentally
// consume list markers that haven't been stripped yet.
const BOLD_ITALIC_RE = /\*{1,2}([^*\n]+)\*{1,2}|_{1,2}([^_\n]+)_{1,2}/g;

// Blockquote prefix  "> "
const BLOCKQUOTE_RE = /^>\s?/gm;

// ATX headings  # heading
const HEADING_RE = /^#{1,6}\s+/gm;

// Markdown links  [text](url)
const LINK_RE = /\[([^\]]+)\]\([^)]+\)/g;

// Markdown list markers  "- " or "* " or "N. " at line start
const LIST_MARKER_RE = /^[ \t]*(?:[-*]|\d+\.)\s+/gm;

// Two or more consecutive stack-trace frames (Node.js style "    at …" lines).
// Matching blocks of ≥2 lets us replace each group in-place, preserving any
// text that follows the trace rather than appending it to the end.
const STACK_BLOCK_RE = /(?:^[ \t]+at [^\n]+(?:\n|$)){2,}/gm;

// Absolute Unix paths optionally ending with :line or :line:col
// Hyphen placed at start of char class to avoid useless-escape lint error
const UNIX_PATH_RE =
  /(?:^|(?<=\s|[(`"']))(\/[-\w.@]+(?:\/[-\w.@]+)*)(:\d+(?::\d+)?)?/g;

// Absolute Windows paths  C:\...  or  C:/...  (any drive letter)
const WIN_PATH_RE =
  /(?:^|(?<=\s|[(`"']))([A-Za-z]:[/\\][-\w. ]+(?:[/\\][-\w. ]+)*)(:\d+(?::\d+)?)?/g;

/**
 * Abbreviates an absolute path to at most `depth` trailing segments,
 * prefixed with "…". Optionally converts `:line` suffix to `line N`.
 */
function abbreviatePath(
  full: string,
  suffix: string | undefined,
  depth: number,
): string {
  const segments = full.split(/[/\\]/).filter(Boolean);
  const kept = segments.length > depth ? segments.slice(-depth) : segments;
  const abbreviated =
    segments.length > depth ? `\u2026/${kept.join('/')}` : full;

  if (!suffix) return abbreviated;
  // Convert ":142" → " line 142", ":142:7" → " line 142"
  const lineNum = suffix.split(':').filter(Boolean)[0];
  return `${abbreviated} line ${lineNum}`;
}

/**
 * Summarises a JSON string as "(JSON object with N keys)" or
 * "(JSON array with N items)", falling back to the original if parsing fails.
 */
function summariseJson(jsonStr: string): string {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(jsonStr);
    if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return `(JSON array with ${parsed.length} item${parsed.length === 1 ? '' : 's'})`;
    }
    if (parsed !== null && typeof parsed === 'object') {
      const keys = Object.keys(parsed).length;
      return `(JSON object with ${keys} key${keys === 1 ? '' : 's'})`;
    }
  } catch {
    // not valid JSON — leave as-is
  }
  return jsonStr;
}

/**
 * Transforms a markdown/ANSI-formatted string into speech-ready plain text.
 *
 * Transformations applied (in order):
 * 1. Strip ANSI escape codes
 * 2. Collapse fenced code blocks to their content (or a JSON summary)
 * 3. Collapse stack traces to first frame + count
 * 4. Strip markdown syntax (bold, italic, blockquotes, headings, links, lists, inline code)
 * 5. Abbreviate deep absolute paths
 * 6. Normalise whitespace
 * 7. Truncate to maxLength
 */
export function formatForSpeech(
  text: string,
  options?: FormatForSpeechOptions,
): string {
  const maxLength = options?.maxLength ?? 500;
  const pathDepth = options?.pathDepth ?? 3;
  const jsonThreshold = options?.jsonThreshold ?? 80;

  if (!text) return '';

  let out = text;

  // 1. Strip ANSI escape codes
  out = out.replace(ANSI_RE, '');

  // 2. Fenced code blocks — try to summarise JSON content, else keep text
  out = out.replace(CODE_FENCE_RE, (_match, body: string) => {
    const trimmed = body.trim();
    if (trimmed.length > jsonThreshold) {
      const summary = summariseJson(trimmed);
      if (summary !== trimmed) return summary;
    }
    return trimmed;
  });

  // 3. Collapse stack traces: replace each contiguous block of ≥2 frames
  //    in-place so that any text after the trace is preserved in order.
  out = out.replace(STACK_BLOCK_RE, (block) => {
    const lines = block
      .trim()
      .split('\n')
      .map((l) => l.trim());
    const rest = lines.length - 1;
    return `${lines[0]} (and ${rest} more frame${rest === 1 ? '' : 's'})\n`;
  });

  // 4. Strip markdown syntax
  out = out
    .replace(INLINE_CODE_RE, '$1')
    .replace(BOLD_ITALIC_RE, (_m, g1?: string, g2?: string) => g1 ?? g2 ?? '')
    .replace(BLOCKQUOTE_RE, '')
    .replace(HEADING_RE, '')
    .replace(LINK_RE, '$1')
    .replace(LIST_MARKER_RE, '');

  // 5. Abbreviate absolute paths
  //    Windows paths first to avoid the leading letter being caught by Unix RE
  out = out.replace(WIN_PATH_RE, (_m, full: string, suffix?: string) =>
    abbreviatePath(full, suffix, pathDepth),
  );
  out = out.replace(UNIX_PATH_RE, (_m, full: string, suffix?: string) =>
    abbreviatePath(full, suffix, pathDepth),
  );

  // 6. Normalise whitespace: collapse multiple blank lines, trim
  out = out.replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim();

  // 7. Truncate
  if (out.length > maxLength) {
    const total = out.length;
    out = out.slice(0, maxLength).trimEnd() + `\u2026 (${total} chars total)`;
  }

  return out;
}

/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2026 Google LLC
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import * as path from 'node:path';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { homedir, GEMINI_DIR } from '../utils/paths.js';
import { GeminiLiveTranscriptionProvider } from './geminiLiveTranscriptionProvider.js';
import { WhisperTranscriptionProvider } from './whisperTranscriptionProvider.js';
import type { TranscriptionProvider } from './transcriptionProvider.js';

export class TranscriptionFactory {
  static createProvider(
    voiceConfig: { backend?: string; whisperModel?: string } | undefined,
    apiKey: string,
  ): TranscriptionProvider {
    const backend = voiceConfig?.backend ?? 'gemini-live';

    if (backend === 'whisper') {
      const modelsDir = path.join(homedir(), GEMINI_DIR, 'whisper_models');
      if (!fs.existsSync(modelsDir)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(modelsDir, { recursive: true });
      }

      const modelName = voiceConfig?.whisperModel ?? 'ggml-base.en.bin';
      const modelPath = path.join(modelsDir, modelName);

      return new WhisperTranscriptionProvider({
        modelPath,
        threads: 4,
        step: 0,
        length: 5000,
      });
    }

    // Default to Gemini Live
    return new GeminiLiveTranscriptionProvider(apiKey);
  }
}

/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2026 Google LLC
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import type { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';

export interface TranscriptionEvents {
  /** Emitted when partial or full transcription text is available. */
  transcription: [string];
  /** Emitted when a speaking turn is considered complete. */
  turnComplete: [];
  /** Emitted when an error occurs during transcription. */
  error: [Error];
  /** Emitted when the transcription service connection is closed. */
  close: [];
}

/**
 * Common interface for all transcription backends (Cloud or Local).
 */
export interface TranscriptionProvider
  extends EventEmitter<TranscriptionEvents> {
  /** Establish connection to the transcription service. */
  connect(): Promise<void>;
  /** Send a chunk of raw audio data to the service. */
  sendAudioChunk(chunk: Buffer): void;
  /** Disconnect from the transcription service. */
  disconnect(): void;
  /** Get the current full transcription for the session. */
  getTranscription(): string;
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi, beforeEach, afterEach } from 'vitest';

import * as os from 'node:os';
import * as path from 'node:path';
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import {
  WhisperModelManager,
  type WhisperModelProgress,
} from './whisperModelManager.js';

const { createWriteStreamSpy } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  createWriteStreamSpy: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('node:fs', async (importOriginal) => {
  const actual = await importOriginal<typeof import('node:fs')>();
  return {
    ...actual,
    createWriteStream: (
      ...args: Parameters<typeof actual.createWriteStream>
    ) =>
      createWriteStreamSpy.getMockImplementation()
        ? createWriteStreamSpy(...args)
        : actual.createWriteStream(...args),
  };
});

function createMockResponse({
  ok = true,
  statusText = 'OK',
  contentLength,
  chunks,
  failAfterChunks,
  failureError = new Error('Network connection lost'),
  chunkDelayMs = 0,
}: {
  ok?: boolean;
  statusText?: string;
  contentLength?: number | null;
  chunks?: Uint8Array[];
  failAfterChunks?: number;
  failureError?: Error;
  chunkDelayMs?: number;
}): Response {
  let index = 0;
  const reader = {
    read: vi.fn(async () => {
      if (chunkDelayMs > 0) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, chunkDelayMs));
      }
      if (failAfterChunks !== undefined && index >= failAfterChunks) {
        throw failureError;
      }
      if (!chunks || index >= chunks.length) {
        return { done: true as const, value: undefined };
      }
      const value = chunks[index++];
      return { done: false as const, value };
    }),
    cancel: vi.fn(async () => {}),
  };

  return {
    ok,
    statusText,
    headers: new Headers(
      contentLength !== undefined && contentLength !== null
        ? { 'content-length': String(contentLength) }
        : {},
    ),
    body: chunks
      ? ({
          getReader: () => reader,
        } as unknown as ReadableStream<Uint8Array>)
      : null,
  } as unknown as Response;
}

function getDownloadingFiles(modelPath: string): string[] {
  const dir = path.dirname(modelPath);
  const base = path.basename(modelPath);
  if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) {
    return [];
  }
  return fs
    .readdirSync(dir)
    .filter((file) => file.startsWith(base) && file.endsWith('.downloading'));
}

describe('WhisperModelManager', () => {
  let tempHomeDir: string;

  beforeEach(() => {
    tempHomeDir = fs.mkdtempSync(
      path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'whisper-model-manager-test-'),
    );
    vi.stubEnv('GEMINI_CLI_HOME', tempHomeDir);
  });

  afterEach(() => {
    vi.restoreAllMocks();
    vi.unstubAllEnvs();
    fs.rmSync(tempHomeDir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  });

  it('validates allowed model names', () => {

      'Unauthorized model name: invalid-model.bin',
    );
    expect(() => manager.getModelPath('invalid-model.bin')).toThrow(
      'Unauthorized model name: invalid-model.bin',
    );
  });

  it('rejects download for unauthorized model names', async () => {
    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    await expect(manager.downloadModel('invalid-model.bin')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Unauthorized model name: invalid-model.bin',
    );
  });

  it('downloads a model to a temporary file, emits progress, and atomically renames on completion', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
      }),
    );

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const progressEvents: WhisperModelProgress[] = [];
    const installedDuringProgress: boolean[] = [];

    manager.on('progress', (progress) => {
      progressEvents.push(progress);
      installedDuringProgress.push(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName));
    });

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);

    await manager.downloadModel(modelName);

    expect(installedDuringProgress).toEqual([false, false]);
    expect(progressEvents).toEqual([
      { modelName, transferred: 4, total: 8, percentage: 0.5 },
      { modelName, transferred: 8, total: 8, percentage: 1 },
    ]);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(true);

    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);
    expect(fs.readFileSync(modelPath)).toEqual(
      Buffer.from([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]),
    );
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('does not leave a partial installed model or temporary file when the response stream fails mid-download', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);

  });

  it('rejects and cleans up temporary file when stream ends before expected content-length', async () => {

    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);

  it('respects write stream backpressure and awaits close before marking model as installed', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    const response = createMockResponse({
      contentLength: 8,
      chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
    });
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(response);

    const mockWriter = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      writable: boolean;
      destroyed: boolean;
      write: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      end: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      destroy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    };
    const writtenChunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
    let tempFilePath = '';

    mockWriter.writable = true;
    mockWriter.destroyed = false;
    mockWriter.write = vi.fn((chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      writtenChunks.push(chunk);
      fs.appendFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.from(chunk));
      // Signal backpressure on first chunk
      return writtenChunks.length > 1;
    });
    mockWriter.end = vi.fn();
    mockWriter.destroy = vi.fn();

    createWriteStreamSpy.mockImplementationOnce((filePath: fs.PathLike) => {
      tempFilePath = String(filePath);
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.alloc(0));
      return mockWriter as unknown as fs.WriteStream;
    });

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    let resolved = false;

    const downloadPromise = manager.downloadModel(modelName).then(() => {
      resolved = true;
    });

    // Wait for first chunk to be written and paused on backpressure
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockWriter.write).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    // Second chunk must not be written before 'drain' is emitted
    expect(mockWriter.write).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(resolved).toBe(false);

    // Emit 'drain' to unblock second chunk
    mockWriter.emit('drain');

    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(mockWriter.write).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
      expect(mockWriter.end).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    // Should still not resolve or mark installed before 'close' is emitted
    expect(resolved).toBe(false);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);

    // Emit 'finish' and 'close' to complete stream flush
    mockWriter.emit('finish');
    mockWriter.emit('close');
    await downloadPromise;

    expect(resolved).toBe(true);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(true);
  });

  it('rejects and removes temporary file when write stream emits an error', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 4,
        chunks: [chunk1],
      }),
    );

    const mockWriter = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      writable: boolean;
      destroyed: boolean;
      write: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      end: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      destroy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    };
    let tempFilePath = '';

    mockWriter.writable = true;
    mockWriter.destroyed = false;
    mockWriter.write = vi.fn((chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      fs.appendFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.from(chunk));
      return true;
    });
    mockWriter.end = vi.fn(() => {
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        mockWriter.emit('error', new Error('ENOSPC: no space left on device'));
        mockWriter.emit('close');
      });
    });
    mockWriter.destroy = vi.fn();

    createWriteStreamSpy.mockImplementationOnce((filePath: fs.PathLike) => {
      tempFilePath = String(filePath);
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.alloc(0));
      return mockWriter as unknown as fs.WriteStream;
    });

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'ENOSPC: no space left on device',
    );

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects and removes temporary file when write stream emits an error while waiting for drain', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
      }),
    );

    const mockWriter = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      writable: boolean;
      destroyed: boolean;
      write: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      end: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      destroy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    };
    let tempFilePath = '';

    mockWriter.writable = true;
    mockWriter.destroyed = false;
    mockWriter.write = vi.fn((chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      fs.appendFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.from(chunk));
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        mockWriter.emit('error', new Error('EIO: i/o error during drain'));
        mockWriter.emit('close');
      });
      return false;
    });
    mockWriter.end = vi.fn();
    mockWriter.destroy = vi.fn();

    createWriteStreamSpy.mockImplementationOnce((filePath: fs.PathLike) => {
      tempFilePath = String(filePath);
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.alloc(0));
      return mockWriter as unknown as fs.WriteStream;
    });

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'EIO: i/o error during drain',
    );

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects and removes temporary file when write stream closes prematurely while waiting for drain', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
      }),
    );

    const mockWriter = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      writable: boolean;
      destroyed: boolean;
      write: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      end: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      destroy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    };
    let tempFilePath = '';

    mockWriter.writable = true;
    mockWriter.destroyed = false;
    mockWriter.write = vi.fn((chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      fs.appendFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.from(chunk));
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        mockWriter.emit('close');
      });
      return false;
    });
    mockWriter.end = vi.fn();
    mockWriter.destroy = vi.fn();

    createWriteStreamSpy.mockImplementationOnce((filePath: fs.PathLike) => {
      tempFilePath = String(filePath);
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.alloc(0));
      return mockWriter as unknown as fs.WriteStream;
    });

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Stream closed before drain',
    );

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects immediately instead of hanging when write stream is already destroyed or not writable on backpressure', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
      }),
    );

    const mockWriter = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      writable: boolean;
      destroyed: boolean;
      write: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      end: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      destroy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    };
    let tempFilePath = '';

    mockWriter.writable = true;
    mockWriter.destroyed = false;
    mockWriter.write = vi.fn((chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      fs.appendFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.from(chunk));
      // Simulate stream closing/destroying synchronously before drain listener is attached
      mockWriter.writable = false;
      mockWriter.destroyed = true;
      mockWriter.emit('close');
      return false;
    });
    mockWriter.end = vi.fn();
    mockWriter.destroy = vi.fn();

    createWriteStreamSpy.mockImplementationOnce((filePath: fs.PathLike) => {
      tempFilePath = String(filePath);
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.alloc(0));
      return mockWriter as unknown as fs.WriteStream;
    });

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Stream is not writable',
    );

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('rejects and removes temporary file when response body is empty (0 bytes)', async () => {
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: null,
        chunks: [],
      }),
    );

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      /Incomplete download/,
    );

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('removes stale .downloading files before starting a new download', async () => {
    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(modelPath), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(`${modelPath}.downloading`, Buffer.from([9, 9, 9]));
    fs.writeFileSync(`${modelPath}.abc123.downloading`, Buffer.from([8, 8, 8]));

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);

    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 4,
        chunks: [new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4])],
      }),
    );

    await manager.downloadModel(modelName);

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.readFileSync(modelPath)).toEqual(Buffer.from([1, 2, 3, 4]));
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('treats a 0-byte model file or directory as not installed', () => {
    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);
    fs.mkdirSync(path.dirname(modelPath), { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(modelPath, Buffer.alloc(0));

    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);

    fs.unlinkSync(modelPath);
    fs.mkdirSync(modelPath);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('rejects when HTTP response is not ok or body is missing', async () => {
    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';

    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValueOnce(
      createMockResponse({
        ok: false,
        statusText: 'Not Found',
      }),
    );
    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Failed to download model: Not Found',
    );

    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValueOnce(
      createMockResponse({
        ok: true,
        chunks: undefined,
      }),
    );
    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Response body is not readable',
    );
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
  });

  it('deduplicates concurrent in-flight downloads for the same model and allows retry after failure', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    const fetchSpy = vi
      .spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch')
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(
        createMockResponse({
          contentLength: 8,
          chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
          chunkDelayMs: 20,
        }),
      )
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(
        createMockResponse({
          ok: false,
          statusText: 'Service Unavailable',
        }),
      )
      .mockResolvedValueOnce(
        createMockResponse({
          contentLength: 4,
          chunks: [chunk1],
        }),
      );

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    const p1 = manager.downloadModel(modelName);
    const p2 = manager.downloadModel(modelName);

    await Promise.all([p1, p2]);

    expect(fetchSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(true);
    expect(fs.readFileSync(modelPath)).toEqual(
      Buffer.from([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]),
    );
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);

    // Subsequent download after failure cleans up in-flight state and can retry
    const otherModel = 'ggml-base.en.bin';
    await expect(manager.downloadModel(otherModel)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Failed to download model: Service Unavailable',
    );
    await manager.downloadModel(otherModel);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(otherModel)).toBe(true);
    expect(fetchSpy).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
  });

  it('calls writer.destroy instead of writer.end when reader fails mid-download', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const failureError = new Error('Connection reset by peer');
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1],
        failAfterChunks: 1,
        failureError,
      }),
    );

    const mockWriter = new EventEmitter() as EventEmitter & {
      writable: boolean;
      destroyed: boolean;
      write: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      end: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
      destroy: ReturnType<typeof vi.fn>;
    };
    let tempFilePath = '';

    mockWriter.writable = true;
    mockWriter.destroyed = false;
    mockWriter.write = vi.fn((chunk: Uint8Array) => {
      fs.appendFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.from(chunk));
      return true;
    });
    mockWriter.end = vi.fn();
    mockWriter.destroy = vi.fn(() => {
      queueMicrotask(() => {
        mockWriter.emit('close');
      });
    });

    createWriteStreamSpy.mockImplementationOnce((filePath: fs.PathLike) => {
      tempFilePath = String(filePath);
      fs.writeFileSync(tempFilePath, Buffer.alloc(0));
      return mockWriter as unknown as fs.WriteStream;
    });

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    await expect(manager.downloadModel(modelName)).rejects.toThrow(
      'Connection reset by peer',
    );

    expect(mockWriter.end).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockWriter.destroy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(failureError);
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('aborts download and cleans up temporary file when AbortSignal is triggered', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    const fetchSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
        chunkDelayMs: 30,
      }),
    );

    const controller = new AbortController();
    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';
    const modelPath = manager.getModelPath(modelName);

    manager.once('progress', () => {
      controller.abort(new Error('User cancelled download'));
    });

    await expect(
      manager.downloadModel(modelName, controller.signal),
    ).rejects.toThrow('User cancelled download');

    expect(fetchSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.stringContaining(modelName),
      expect.objectContaining({ signal: expect.any(AbortSignal) }),
    );
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(false);
    expect(fs.existsSync(modelPath)).toBe(false);
    expect(getDownloadingFiles(modelPath)).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('respects AbortSignal for individual callers without aborting shared download while other callers remain active', async () => {
    const chunk1 = new Uint8Array([1, 2, 3, 4]);
    const chunk2 = new Uint8Array([5, 6, 7, 8]);
    vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'fetch').mockResolvedValue(
      createMockResponse({
        contentLength: 8,
        chunks: [chunk1, chunk2],
        chunkDelayMs: 30,
      }),
    );

    const manager = new WhisperModelManager();
    const modelName = 'ggml-tiny.en.bin';

    const firstController = new AbortController();
    const firstPromise = manager.downloadModel(
      modelName,
      firstController.signal,
    );

    const secondController = new AbortController();
    const secondPromise = manager.downloadModel(
      modelName,
      secondController.signal,
    );

    const thirdPromise = manager.downloadModel(modelName);

    // Pre-aborted signal on deduplicated call rejects immediately
    const preAbortedController = new AbortController();
    preAbortedController.abort(new Error('Already aborted caller'));
    await expect(
      manager.downloadModel(modelName, preAbortedController.signal),
    ).rejects.toThrow('Already aborted caller');

    // First caller aborting rejects only first caller while others remain active
    firstController.abort(new Error('First caller cancelled'));
    await expect(firstPromise).rejects.toThrow('First caller cancelled');

    // Second caller aborting rejects only second caller while third caller remains active
    secondController.abort(new Error('Second caller cancelled'));
    await expect(secondPromise).rejects.toThrow('Second caller cancelled');

    // Third caller still completes normally
    await thirdPromise;
    expect(manager.isModelInstalled(modelName)).toBe(true);
  });
});

/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2026 Google LLC
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import * as path from 'node:path';
import * as fs from 'node:fs';
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import { homedir, GEMINI_DIR } from '../utils/paths.js';
import { debugLogger } from '../utils/debugLogger.js';

export interface WhisperModelProgress {
  modelName: string;
  transferred: number;
  total: number;
  percentage: number;
}

export interface WhisperModelManagerEvents {
  progress: [WhisperModelProgress];
}

const ALLOWED_MODELS = [
  'ggml-tiny.en.bin',
  'ggml-base.en.bin',
  'ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin',
  'ggml-large-v3-turbo-q8_0.bin',
];

interface InFlightDownload {
  promise: Promise<void>;
  controller: AbortController;
  activeCallers: number;
}

/**
 * Manages Whisper models (checking existence, downloading).
 */
export class WhisperModelManager extends EventEmitter<WhisperModelManagerEvents> {
  private readonly modelsDir: string;
  private readonly inFlightDownloads = new Map<string, InFlightDownload>();

  constructor() {
    super();
    this.modelsDir = path.join(homedir(), GEMINI_DIR, 'whisper_models');
  }

  isModelInstalled(modelName: string): boolean {
    this.validateModelName(modelName);
    const modelPath = path.join(this.modelsDir, modelName);
    try {
      const stat = fs.statSync(modelPath);
      return stat.isFile() && stat.size > 0;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  getModelPath(modelName: string): string {
    this.validateModelName(modelName);
    return path.join(this.modelsDir, modelName);
  }

  async downloadModel(modelName: string, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
    this.validateModelName(modelName);

    if (signal?.aborted) {
      throw this.getAbortError(signal);
    }

    let inFlight = this.inFlightDownloads.get(modelName);
    if (!inFlight) {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      const promise = this.executeDownload(
        modelName,
        controller.signal,
      ).finally(() => {
        this.inFlightDownloads.delete(modelName);
      });
      promise.catch(() => {});
      inFlight = { promise, controller, activeCallers: 0 };
      this.inFlightDownloads.set(modelName, inFlight);
    }

    inFlight.activeCallers += 1;
    const currentInFlight = inFlight;

    if (!signal) {
      return currentInFlight.promise;
    }

    return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      let settled = false;
      const onAbort = () => {
        if (settled) return;
        const abortError = this.getAbortError(signal);
        currentInFlight.activeCallers -= 1;
        if (currentInFlight.activeCallers <= 0) {
          currentInFlight.controller.abort(abortError);
        } else {
          settled = true;
          reject(abortError);
        }
      };
      signal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
      currentInFlight.promise.then(
        () => {
          if (settled) return;
          settled = true;
          signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
          resolve();
        },
        (err) => {
          if (settled) return;
          settled = true;
          signal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
          reject(err);
        },
      );
    });
  }

  private getAbortError(signal?: AbortSignal): Error {
    return signal?.reason instanceof Error
      ? signal.reason
      : new DOMException('The operation was aborted.', 'AbortError');
  }

  private async executeDownload(
    modelName: string,
    signal?: AbortSignal,
  ): Promise<void> {
    signal?.throwIfAborted();

    await fs.promises.mkdir(this.modelsDir, { recursive: true });

    const destination = path.join(this.modelsDir, modelName);
    const tempDestination = `${destination}.${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2)}.downloading`;
    const url = `https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/resolve/main/${modelName}`;

    debugLogger.debug(
      `[WhisperModelManager] Downloading ${modelName} from ${url}`,
    );

    const response = await fetch(url, signal ? { signal } : undefined);
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to download model: ${response.statusText}`);
    }

    const total = parseInt(response.headers.get('content-length') || '0', 10);
    let transferred = 0;

    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
    if (!reader) {
      throw new Error('Response body is not readable');
    }

    try {
      const files = await fs.promises.readdir(this.modelsDir);
      for (const file of files) {
        if (
          (file === modelName + '.downloading' ||
            file.startsWith(modelName + '.')) &&
          file.endsWith('.downloading')
        ) {
          await fs.promises
            .unlink(path.join(this.modelsDir, file))
            .catch(() => {});
        }
      }
    } catch {
      // Ignore directory read errors
    }

    const writer = fs.createWriteStream(tempDestination);
    let streamError: Error | null = null;
    const closePromise = new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
      writer.once('close', () => {
        if (streamError) {
          reject(streamError);
        } else {
          resolve();
        }
      });
      writer.once('error', (err) => {
        streamError = err;
        void reader.cancel?.().catch(() => {});
      });
    });
    closePromise.catch(() => {});

    const onAbort = () => {
      const abortError =
        signal?.reason instanceof Error
          ? signal.reason
          : new DOMException('The operation was aborted.', 'AbortError');
      streamError = abortError;
      void reader.cancel?.(abortError).catch(() => {});
      writer.destroy(abortError);
    };
    signal?.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    if (signal?.aborted) {
      onAbort();
    }

    try {
      while (true) {
        signal?.throwIfAborted();
        const { done, value } = await reader.read();
        if (streamError) {
          throw streamError;
        }
        signal?.throwIfAborted();
        if (done) break;

        transferred += value.length;
        const writeOk = writer.write(value);
        if (streamError) {
          throw streamError;
        }
        if (!writeOk) {
          if (writer.destroyed || !writer.writable) {
            throw streamError ?? new Error('Stream is not writable');
          }
          await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
            if (streamError) {
              reject(streamError);
              return;
            }
            if (signal?.aborted) {
              reject(streamError ?? this.getAbortError(signal));
              return;
            }
            const onDrain = () => {
              cleanup();
              resolve();
            };
            const onError = (err: Error) => {
              cleanup();
              reject(err);
            };
            const onClose = () => {
              cleanup();
              reject(new Error('Stream closed before drain'));
            };
            const onSignalAbort = () => {
              cleanup();
              reject(streamError ?? this.getAbortError(signal));
            };
            const cleanup = () => {
              writer.off('drain', onDrain);
              writer.off('error', onError);
              writer.off('close', onClose);
              signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onSignalAbort);
            };
            writer.once('drain', onDrain);
            writer.once('error', onError);
            writer.once('close', onClose);
            signal?.addEventListener('abort', onSignalAbort, { once: true });
          });
        }

        const percentage = total > 0 ? transferred / total : 0;
        this.emit('progress', {
          modelName,
          transferred,
          total,
          percentage,
        });
      }

      writer.end();
      await closePromise;

      if (transferred === 0 || (total > 0 && transferred !== total)) {
        throw new Error(
          `Incomplete download for ${modelName}: expected ${total} bytes, received ${transferred} bytes`,
        );
      }

      await fs.promises.rename(tempDestination, destination);
    } catch (error) {
      writer.destroy(error instanceof Error ? error : undefined);
      await closePromise.catch(() => {});
      await fs.promises.unlink(tempDestination).catch(() => {});
      throw error;
    } finally {
      signal?.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    }
  }

  private validateModelName(modelName: string): void {
    if (!ALLOWED_MODELS.includes(modelName)) {
      throw new Error(`Unauthorized model name: ${modelName}`);
    }
  }
}

/**
 * @license
 * Copyright 2026 Google LLC
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import { spawn, type ChildProcessWithoutNullStreams } from 'node:child_process';
import { EventEmitter } from 'node:events';
import commandExists from 'command-exists';
import { debugLogger } from '../utils/debugLogger.js';
import type {
  TranscriptionProvider,
  TranscriptionEvents,
} from './transcriptionProvider.js';

export interface WhisperProviderOptions {
  modelPath: string;
  threads?: number;
  step?: number;
  length?: number;
}

/**
 * Local transcription provider using `whisper-stream` from whisper.cpp.
 *
 * Uses the Sliding Window Mode with VAD (--step 0) for stable,
 * non-overlapping transcription blocks that can be appended directly.
 */
export class WhisperTranscriptionProvider
  extends EventEmitter<TranscriptionEvents>
  implements TranscriptionProvider
{
  private process: ChildProcessWithoutNullStreams | null = null;
  private currentTranscription = '';

  constructor(private readonly options: WhisperProviderOptions) {
    super();
  }

  /**
   * Checks if `whisper-stream` is available on the system.
   */
  static async isAvailable(): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
      await commandExists('whisper-stream');
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }

  async connect(): Promise<void> {
    const { modelPath, threads = 4, step = 0, length = 5000 } = this.options;

    this.currentTranscription = '';

    const available = await WhisperTranscriptionProvider.isAvailable();
    if (!available) {
      return Promise.reject(
        new Error(
          'The `whisper-stream` command is required for local voice mode. Please install it (e.g., `brew install whisper-cpp` on macOS).',
        ),
      );
    }

    debugLogger.debug(
      `[WhisperTranscription] Starting whisper-stream with model: ${modelPath} (VAD mode: step=${step}, length=${length})`,
    );

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      let isResolved = false;

      try {
        // whisper-stream -m <model_path> -t <threads> --step 0 --length <length> -vth 0.6
        // Setting step == 0 enables sliding window mode with VAD, which outputs
        // non-overlapping transcription blocks suitable for appending.
        this.process = spawn('whisper-stream', [
          '-m',
          modelPath,
          '-t',
          threads.toString(),
          '--step',
          step.toString(),
          '--length',
          length.toString(),
          '-vth',
          '0.6',
        ]);

        this.process.stdout.on('data', (data: Buffer) => {
          const output = data.toString();
          this.parseOutput(output);
        });

        this.process.stderr.on('data', (data: Buffer) => {
          const msg = data.toString();
          if (msg.includes('error')) {
            debugLogger.error(`[WhisperTranscription] stderr: ${msg}`);
            if (!isResolved) {
              isResolved = true;
              reject(new Error(msg));
            }
          }

          // whisper-stream prints "whisper_init_from_file_with_params_no_state: loading model from..."
          // and finally "main: processing, press Ctrl+C to stop" when ready.
          if (!isResolved && msg.includes('main: processing')) {
            debugLogger.debug('[WhisperTranscription] whisper-stream is ready');
            isResolved = true;
            resolve();
          }
        });

        this.process.on('error', (err) => {
          debugLogger.error('[WhisperTranscription] Process error:', err);
          this.emit('error', err);
          if (!isResolved) {
            isResolved = true;
            reject(err);
          }
        });

        this.process.on('close', (code) => {
          debugLogger.debug(
            `[WhisperTranscription] Process closed with code ${code}`,
          );
          this.emit('close');
          this.process = null;
        });

        // Fallback timeout in case "main: processing" is never seen
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (!isResolved) {
            debugLogger.warn(
              '[WhisperTranscription] Connection timeout (fallback resolve)',
            );
            isResolved = true;
            resolve();
          }
        }, 10000);
      } catch (err) {
        debugLogger.error(
          '[WhisperTranscription] Failed to spawn process:',
          err,
        );
        if (!isResolved) {
          isResolved = true;
          reject(err);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  private parseOutput(output: string): void {
    // whisper-stream output format: "[00:00:00.000 --> 00:00:02.000]   Hello world."
    const lines = output.split('\n');

    for (const line of lines) {
      const match = line.match(/\[.* --> .*\]\s+(.*)/);
      if (match && match[1]) {
        let text = match[1].trim();

        // Filter out [Silence], [music], (laughter), etc.
        text = text
          .replace(/\[[^\]]*\]/g, '')
          .replace(/\([^)]*\)/g, '')
          .trim();

        if (text) {
          // In VAD mode (step=0), each line is a completed speech block.
          // Append it to the buffer to ensure it doesn't disappear.
          this.currentTranscription = this.currentTranscription
            ? `${this.currentTranscription} ${text}`
            : text;

          debugLogger.debug(
            `[WhisperTranscription] Transcription updated (Local-VAD): "${this.currentTranscription}"`,
          );
          this.emit('transcription', this.currentTranscription);
        }
      }
    }
  }

  sendAudioChunk(_chunk: Buffer): void {
    // whisper-stream handles its own audio capture.
  }

  getTranscription(): string {
    return this.currentTranscription;
  }

  disconnect(): void {
    if (this.process) {
      this.process.kill('SIGTERM');
      this.process = null;
    }
  }
}

FILE: packages/devtools/GEMINI.md
================================================
# Gemini CLI DevTools

Integrated Developer Tools for Gemini CLI, providing a Chrome DevTools-like
interface for Network and Console inspection. Launched automatically when the
`general.devtools` setting is enabled.

## Features

- **Network Inspector**: Real-time request/response logging with streaming
  chunks and duration tracking
- **Console Inspector**: Real-time console log viewing
  (log/warn/error/debug/info)
- **Session Management**: Multiple CLI session support with live connection
  status
- **Import/Export**: Import JSONL log files, export current session logs

## How It Works

When `general.devtools` is enabled, the CLI's `devtoolsService` automatically:

1. Probes port 25417 for an existing DevTools instance
2. If found, connects as a WebSocket client
3. If not, starts a new DevTools server and connects to it
4. If another instance races for the port, the loser connects to the winner

No environment variables needed for normal use.

## Architecture

```
gemini.tsx / nonInteractiveCli.ts
         │  (dynamic import)
         ▼
  devtoolsService.ts          ← orchestration + DevTools lifecycle
         │  (imports)
         ▼
  activityLogger.ts           ← pure logging (capture, file, WebSocket transport)
         │  (events)
         ▼
  DevTools server (:25417)    ← this package (HTTP + WebSocket + SSE)
         │  (SSE /events)
         ▼
  DevTools UI (React)         ← client/ compiled by esbuild
```

## Environment Variables

| Variable                         | Description                                   |
| -------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- |
| `GEMINI_CLI_ACTIVITY_LOG_TARGET` | File path for JSONL mode (optional, fallback) |

## API Endpoints

| Endpoint                | Method    | Description                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/ws`                   | WebSocket | Log ingestion from CLI sessions (register, network, console)                |
| `/events`               | SSE       | Pushes snapshot on connect, then incremental network/console/session events |
| `/api/trigger-debugger` | POST      | Triggers the Node.js debugger for a specific CLI session via WebSocket      |

## Development

```bash
# Build everything (client + server)
npm run build

# Rebuild client only after UI changes
npm run build:client
```

### Project Structure

```
packages/devtools/
├── src/
│   └── index.ts           # DevTools server (HTTP, WebSocket, SSE)
├── client/
│   ├── index.html
│   └── src/
│       ├── main.tsx        # React entry
│       ├── App.tsx         # DevTools UI
│       └── hooks.ts        # Data fetching hooks
├── esbuild.client.js       # Client build script
└── dist/                   # Build output
    ├── src/index.js        # Compiled server
    └── client/             # Bundled client assets
```
